b5e23d4d.description:
**Team Lead \| Wintel \| Bengaluru \| Engineering \| Hybrid Cloud Engineering**
  

* **Job requisition ID** : 106880
* **Location**: Bengaluru
* **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**Team Lead** **\|** **Engineering, AI \& Data – Engineering \|** **Wintel**

 **Location:** Bangalore

  


**The team**



Engineering helps empower and drive mission\-critical solutions whether we need to modernize existing systems or implement new technology products and platforms. Through innovation, we improve financial performance, accelerate new digital businesses and fuel growth. Learn more about Engineering, AI and Data

  


**Your work profile**



As a Team Lead at Deloitte you are responsible to support and optimize enterprise Windows Server and VMWare environments across data centers and hybrid infrastructures. This role requires deep hands\-on experience in Windows Server management, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, patching, clustering, VMWare Virtualization and performance troubleshooting.



The Senior Consultant will provide advanced technical support (L2/L3\), lead critical operational tasks, participate in infrastructure improvement initiatives, and ensure the stability, security, and reliability of Wintel platforms.

  



Windows


* Windows, Clustering, Patching, AD, DNS, OVM,Vmware, Azure


* Manage, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows Server environments (2012/2016/2019/2022\).


* Perform server provisioning, OS installation, configuration, hardening, and lifecycle management.


* Conduct regular health checks, performance tuning, and capacity analysis of Windows server infrastructure.


* Administer Active Directory including user/group management, OU structures, GPO creation and troubleshooting, domain controller maintenance, replication health, and FSMO roles. Manage and troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, DFS, and other core Windows services.


* Implement and review AD security policies, authentication mechanisms, and domain hardening standards.


* Support and maintain Windows Failover Clusters for mission\-critical workloads (file clusters, application clusters, SQL clusters, Hyper\-V clusters, etc.).


* Perform cluster validation, failover testing, quorum configuration, and performance monitoring.


* Troubleshoot node issues, cluster communication failures, heartbeat problems, and HA\-related incidents.

* Drive performance tuning and optimization


* Support cloud migrations and workload onboarding

  



**Key skills required:**


* Education\-Bachelors in Engineering


* 4\+ years of experience in Wintel/Windows Server administration.


* Experience supporting mid\-to\-large scale enterprise Windows environments.


* Strong expertise in Windows Server administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.


* Hands\-on experience with Active Directory, GPOs, DNS, DHCP, DFS, and related infrastructure services.


* Solid knowledge of Windows Failover Clustering, HA concepts, quorum configuration, and cluster diagnostics.


* Experience with WSUS, SCCM, or other patching and configuration management tools.


* Working knowledge of VMware/Hyper\-V virtualization environments.


* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation of routine tasks.


* Strong exposure to incident, change, and problem management (ITIL framework).


* Ability to handle high\-priority incidents and drive root\-cause analysis.


* Strong fundamentals in: Virtualization (VMware/Nutanix)


* Storage (SAN/NAS/HCI)
* Networking basics (VLAN, routing, firewall concepts)
* Linux/Windows OS admin


* Basic scripting (PowerShell/Bash/Python)


* Understanding of backup tools (Veeam/Commvault/etc.)


* Exposure to containers/Kubernetes/OpenShift (preferred)


* Microsoft certifications (MCSA / MCSE / Azure Administrator / Windows Server Hybrid Administrator).


* VCP / Nutanix NCA / RHCSA


* Experience in Managed Services or large enterprise infrastructure environments.


* Understanding of security frameworks, endpoint protection, and compliance standards.

**Service Line:** 
 Digital Engineering
   

  

**Industry Focus:**

**Level:** 
 Associate Director

 **Associate Director – Life Sciences Delivery Lead** 
 to lead and scale digital engineering engagements for global Life Sciences clients. The role requires executive stakeholder management, commercial acumen, and the ability to lead distributed global teams while ensuring delivery excellence and business outcomes.
 **Key Responsibilities** 
**Client Leadership \& Account Growth** 
 Serve as a trusted advisor to client executives, business sponsors, and technology leaders.Build and strengthen executive relationships across existing and new client accounts.Identify and drive account growth opportunities through cross\-selling and upselling of Digital Engineering services.Support proposals, solutioning, deal shaping, estimations, and client presentations.Contribute to annual revenue growth, pipeline development, and strategic account planning.
 **Delivery \& Program Leadership** 
 Own a portfolio of Life Sciences engagements with accountability for delivery excellence, financial performance, and customer satisfaction.Lead large\-scale digital transformation programs covering product engineering, platform modernization, cloud transformation, AI, data, automation, and integration initiatives.Establish robust governance frameworks, delivery metrics, risk management processes, and executive reporting mechanisms.Drive predictable delivery across scope, quality, schedule, budget, and business outcomes.Ensure compliance with Life Sciences regulatory and quality requirements where applicable.
 **Digital Engineering Leadership** 
 Drive adoption of modern engineering practices including:AI\-assisted software engineeringProduct\-centric delivery modelsCloud\-native architecturePlatform engineeringDevSecOpsQuality EngineeringIntelligent Automation and GenAIChampion engineering productivity through reusable assets, accelerators, automation, and AI\-enabled delivery methods.Partner with architects and engineering leaders to define technology roadmaps and transformation strategies.
 **Life Sciences Domain Leadership** 
 Provide strategic direction across:Clinical DevelopmentRegulatory AffairsQuality \& ComplianceMedical AffairsPharmacovigilanceCommercial OperationsResearch \& DevelopmentManufacturing and Supply ChainGuide clients on digital transformation opportunities within regulated and highly compliant environments.Stay current on industry trends, technology innovations, and emerging Life Sciences platforms.
 **People Leadership \& Capability Building** 
 Lead and mentor Delivery Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, and Delivery Leads.Build high\-performing teams and succession pipelines.Drive hiring, talent development, performance coaching, and workforce planning.Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.Contribute to Life Sciences Digital Engineering capability development, thought leadership, and market positioning.
 **Operational \& Financial Management** 
 Own engagement profitability, revenue realization, utilization, and delivery KPIs.Drive forecasting, resource planning, capacity management, and financial governance.Proactively identify, mitigate, and escalate delivery risks.Ensure effective management of vendors, partners, and extended delivery organizations.
 **Required Qualifications** 
**Experience** 
 15–18 years of overall IT and Digital Transformation experience.Minimum 8 years in delivery leadership roles managing large\-scale engineering programs.Minimum 5 years supporting Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, MedTech, or Healthcare clients.Proven experience managing global delivery teams exceeding 100\+ resources across multiple workstreams.Demonstrated experience owning multimillion\-dollar technology engagements.
 **Life Sciences Expertise** 
 Strong understanding of one or more of:Clinical Trials and Clinical OperationsRegulatory AffairsPharmacovigilanceQuality Management SystemsMedical AffairsCommercial OperationsManufacturing and Supply ChainPatient Services and Engagement
 **Technology \& Engineering Expertise** 
 Experience leading initiatives involving:Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)Modern application developmentAPI and integration ecosystemsData and AI platformsDigital product engineeringPlatform modernizationDevSecOps and Quality EngineeringAgile and Product Delivery Models
 **Key Success Measures** 
 Revenue growth and account expansion.Customer satisfaction and stakeholder trust.Delivery predictability, quality, and operational excellence.Engagement profitability and resource utilization.AI and digital engineering adoption across client portfolios.Talent retention, leadership development, and capability growth.Contribution to Life Sciences practice development and market positioning.
 **Ideal Candidate Profile** 
 A highly credible delivery leader with strong Life Sciences industry expertise, proven experience managing strategic client relationships, and a track record of successfully delivering complex Digital Engineering transformations at scale. The individual should be equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with client executives, shaping growth opportunities, and leading large global engineering teams to deliver measurable value.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

e7b89a79.title: Solution Architect - Embedded & Enterprise Linux (Presales)
e7b89a79.description:
**Title:** 
**Senior Solution Architect**
**Location:** 
**India**
**Wind River**
 Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission\-critical intelligent systems, a subsidiary of Aptiv. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy.
   

  

 The company’s software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions — such as Artemis I \& II, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers — and in recent 5G milestones — including the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and in building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone.
   

  

 The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where they lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion \& belonging, come join us and help advance the future software\-defined world.
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
**Interface \& Collaboration**
 The team you will represent is pivotal in acting as the senior solution architect (or technical presales) and product specialists to close deals and create demand for Wind River solutions. This person holds and understands the market, project, and application of our customers, and promotes the adoption of Wind River products and services in Intelligent edge systems, such as Industrial, Aerospace \& Defense systems.
   

  

 You will be an integral part of the Solution Architect Organization in APJ and focus on India Embedded \& Enterprise business, cover Industrial, Aerospace and Defense, IT \& Networking solutions. You will collaborate with Account Managers who act as a hunter role with a focus on net new logo/business acquisition.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understand customer’s technical needs, architecting technical solutions using Wind River and Third party products,and demonstrating them through product presentations, Discovery/Technical workshops, proof of concepts/values, and evaluations to win the technical sale.
* Serve as a single technical point of contact, become the customer's trusted advisor and the Wind River solutions expert.
* Manage all technical needs of account utilizing all available resources.
* Manage technical resources to effectively manage customer product life\-cycle needs.
* Exhibit leadership skills during customer requirements analysis and creating technical solutions.
* Develop territory and regional (multi\-site) technical account plans and help the Account managers to build business account plans and execute successfully.
* Listen to customer's needs, architect solutions and present value proposition.
* Manage Trade Show demos and Seminars.
* Provide consistent market feedback to Wind River.
* Remove technical barriers for Wind River solutions.
* Increase Wind River mind share with each customer.


**About You**
**Core Competencies \& Demonstrated Success**
* Motivated to grow the business by leveraging strong technical expertise and solution selling capability, including introducing and selling new products confidently.
* Positive, proactive attitude toward learning and mastering new technologies and products, and applying them to real customer use cases.
* Able to understand customers’ projects and applications in depth and formulate appropriate technical and commercial proposals.
* Skilled in creating and delivering tailored presentations and live demonstrations that address specific audience needs and decision criteria.
* Strong ability to communicate, influence, and build trust with key stakeholders at all levels of the organization, across functions and geographies.
* Demonstrated capability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high attention to detail and follow through.
* Strong C/C\+\+ development, debugging, and problem solving skills. Able to support deep technical discussions.
* Effective technical communication skills, including whiteboarding, technical presentations, demonstrations, and solution qualification.
* Embedded software development and system architecture experience (e.g., RTOS, Linux) is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with safety and security standards for Industrial/Rail and Aerospace (e.g., IEC 61508, EN 50128, DO‑178\) is an advantage.
* Experience with certified software and certification processes is a plus.
* Experience with system emulation technologies such as QEMU is a plus.
* Deep expertise in Enterprise Linux platforms (e.g., eLxr Pro, Wind River Linux, RHEL, SUSE, Ubuntu, Rocky/Alma), including architecture design, hardening, and lifecycle management.
* Strong proficiency in automation and infrastructure as code(IaC) to standardize builds, configuration, and operations.
* Ability to translate business and application requirements into end to end Linux architecture blueprints, guiding implementation and defining technical standards


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a closely related field is required
* Professional certifications such as RHCE, SUSE Certified Architect, or equivalent senior level Linux credentials are required.
* 8–12 years of experience in embedded software and enterprise Linux, including hands on capability to design, build, and demonstrate solutions.
* Experience in embedded and enterprise software development with RTOS and Linux, covering both application and system level work.
* Proven experience supporting software development for embedded and enterprise system applications (e.g., debugging, optimization, integration).
* Experience in field applications engineering for embedded SoCs, evaluation boards, and Linux/RTOS/BSP products is preferred.
* Embedded and Enterprise Linux or RTOS background covering deployment, image build, and kernel/application development is preferred.
* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
* Prior experience working with overseas teams or in an international software company is a plus.


**Benefits \& Perks**
* Social Insurance
* Group life and Medical Insurance
* Annual Leave
* Summer Vacation
* Special Leave
* Birthday and Volunteer Time off
* Competitive Benefits Package
* Training Subsidies
* Employee Assistance Program


 Wind River is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to diversity. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

The ideal candidate should have expertise in Next Experience, UI Builder, portal modernization, workflow automation, and enterprise integrations, with the ability to deliver intuitive, scalable solutions that align with business needs.

* Implement and configure AI\-enabled ServiceNow solutions.

* Build and optimize workflows using Flow Designer and ServiceNow automation capabilities.
* Implement AI capabilities such as Now Assist, AI Search, or Virtual Agent.
* Develop integrations using Integration Hub, REST APIs, and third\-party systems.

* 6–12 years of IT experience with 5\+ years in ServiceNow implementation.

* Strong knowledge of Flow Designer, Workflow Automation, Integration Hub, REST APIs, and enterprise integrations.

59d51117.title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer - CL
59d51117.description:
Full\-time
**Company Description**
-----------------------


Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.  

  

By combining world\-class engineering, industry expertise and a people\-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.  

  

From prototype to real\-world impact \- be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.**Job Description**
-------------------


You will be the primary architect and operator of our multi\-cloud ecosystem. This is a high\-impact, generalist role that requires a deep understanding of the entire technology stack—from the underlying operating systems and networking to container orchestration and automated governance. You will design, secure, and scale the infrastructure that powers our global applications while mentoring engineering teams on cloud\-native best practices.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement secure, multi\-account structures and landing zones across AWS.
* Manage and evolve multi\-cloud IAM, SSO, and Role\-Based Access Controls (RBAC) to ensure least\-privilege access.
* Enforce tagging standards, resource hierarchies, and cost\-optimization strategies (rightsizing, idle resource elimination) to maintain fiscal accountability.
* Lead the deployment, scaling, and management of Kubernetes clusters (EKS, GKE, or self\-managed). Manage CNI plugins, ingress controllers, and service meshes (Istio/Linkerd).
* Administer and optimize Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL) and Windows Server environments, ensuring hardened configurations and automated patching.
* Manage the intersection of cloud services and traditional OS\-level dependencies, including Active Directory integration and file system performance tuning.
* Develop and maintain modular templates using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
* Build and optimize deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Flux, or ArgoCD to enable "GitOps" workflows.
* Design security controls including encryption at rest/transit (KMS), VPC Service Controls, and audit logging to meet SOC2, HIPAA, or FedRAMP standards.
* Leverage AI\-native development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and LLM\-powered agents to accelerate Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) authoring, automate complex root\-cause analysis, and proactively optimize cloud utilization through predictive anomaly detection.
* Integrate SonarQube into CI/CD pipelines and manage secure, role\-based, auditable infrastructure access using StrongDM.
**Qualifications**
------------------

**Experience You’ll Need**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience

**Required AWS Skills**

* Strong hands\-on experience with **EC2, VPC, IAM, Security Groups, Route 53, S3, EBS, EFS, ELB/ALB, Auto Scaling, CloudWatch, KMS, SNS, and Lambda**.
* Experience managing containerized workloads using **ECS and/or EKS**.
* Good understanding of **AWS networking**, including VPCs, public/private subnets, NAT Gateway, Internet Gateway, Route Tables, VPN, and VPC Peering.
* Experience implementing IAM roles, policies, and least\-privilege access.
* Knowledge of backup, disaster recovery, and high availability architectures.

**Infrastructure as Code**

* Strong experience with **Terraform** for provisioning and managing AWS infrastructure.
* Good understanding of Terraform modules, remote state, workspaces, variables, and state management.
* Exposure to **AWS CloudFormation** is desirable.

**CI/CD \& Automation**

* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Experience automating deployments and infrastructure provisioning.

**Monitoring \& Logging**

* Hands\-on experience with **CloudWatch**, CloudTrail, and centralized logging.
* Experience creating alarms, dashboards, and monitoring infrastructure health.

**Containers**

* Good understanding of Docker.
* Experience deploying and managing applications on ECS or EKS.
* Knowledge of Amazon ECR.

**Security**

* Experience implementing AWS security best practices.
* Knowledge of Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, encryption (KMS), and compliance principles.
**Additional Information**
--------------------------


At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

87e964c9.description:
Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum. Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum, people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. While we continue updating the Solventum Careers Page and applicant materials, some documents may still reflect legacy branding. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/legal/website\-privacy\-statement/applicant\-privacy/ applies to any personal information you submit. As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.**Job Description:**

**AI Architect – Modern AI Applications**  

3M Health Care is now Solventum  

  

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game\-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.  

  

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.  

  

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**  

  

As a AI Architect with deep expertise in Machine learning, Agentic AI, Generative AI, and Natural Language Understanding (NLU), you will lead high\-impact AI Platform development for HIS applications. In this role, you will be a hands\-on research and development leader \- driving technical breakthroughs, designing novel AI architectures, and directly influencing the integration of advanced AI into mission\-critical healthcare products. You will collaborate closely with other scientists, engineers, and domain experts to create platform/solutions that are explainable, reliable, and transformative for healthcare operations.  

  

This role is focused on building scalable AI platforms and frameworks from scratch and is not a data science or model experimentation role.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

**Healthcare\-Focused AI Development**

* Architect, design and develop AI platform to support large language models to handle healthcare\-specific language, regulatory requirements, and ethical considerations.
* Frameworks which can support AI pipelines that can process structured and unstructured healthcare data (FHIR, HL7, clinical notes, claims data).
* Contribute to domain\-specific model architectures that improve clinical decision\-making, revenue cycle management, and patient engagement.

**Technical Leadership**

* Serve as the primary technical authority on any AI Platform related development within product teams.
* Mentor junior AI designers and engineers through code reviews, research guidance, and technical workshops.
* Drive internal knowledge\-sharing on emerging AI trends, frameworks, and best practices.

**Operational \& Compliance Excellence**

* Implement rigorous model evaluation frameworks for accuracy, robustness, and fairness.
* Ensure compliance with healthcare privacy and data security regulations (HIPAA, HITRUST).
* Partner with engineering to move research prototypes into production environments.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or related field AND 10\+ years of experience in developing AI/ML platform on Cloud \& on\-Prem.


Or

* 15\+ software engineering background in AI, Machine Learning, or related field with 10\+ years of experience in building AI/ML platforms.
* Proficiency in Python, and modern ML libraries.
* Experience with GenAI, LLMs, transformer architectures, and advanced **Model Routing** (dynamically selecting and orchestrating open\-source vs. proprietary models based on latency, cost, and capability tiers).
* Skilled with AI development tools and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Deep expertise in building enterprise\-grade **RAG systems**, including advanced chunking, hybrid search, vector database management, and retrieval optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with autonomous AI agents and reasoning systems, specifically mastering **Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) communication protocols** and the **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** for multi\-agent orchestration.
* Advanced skills in **Agent** **Context Management**, including context window optimization, stateful memory injection, caching strategies, and managing long\-running agent contexts.
* Proven ability in Observability, Logging, and Scalable systems, including specialized **LLM/Agent tracing** to monitor reasoning steps, token usage, and system latency.
* Strong track record applying AI architectures to scalable, generic enterprise platforms and complex use cases.
* Strong background with cloud platforms, On\-Prem deployments, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.
* Strong background in containerization and infrastructure as code (Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.).

  

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with **Knowledge Graph DBs** (e.g., Neo4j), NoSQL/SQL databases, and native Vector databases, particularly in designing advanced **GraphRAG** and hybrid\-retrieval architectures.
* Familiarity with advanced multi\-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel) for complex, stateful workflow execution.
* Proven ability to take complex AI Architecture/Design—especially non\-deterministic LLM and multi\-agent systems—from concept to highly available, production\-grade deployments.
* Experience with **LLM Evaluation** frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, LLM\-as\-a\-Judge) to continuously monitor and score agent reasoning and RAG retrieval quality.
* Knowledge of **model fine\-tuning techniques** (LoRA, PEFT) and model distillation to create smaller, task\-specific models that optimize cost and latency within the model routing layer.
* Familiarity with implementing platform\-wide AI guardrails, prompt injection defenses, and output validation mechanisms.

  

  

For current employees, internal transfer restrictions may not apply. For more details, contact your local recruiter/HR team.  

  

**Work location:**

* United States

  

  

**Supporting Your Well\-being**  

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

  



Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.


Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com**. Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1\) uploading a resume, or 2\) entering the information into the application fields directly.**

Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at Solventum are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.


Please access the linked document by clicking here. Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the

e76075bf.title: Sr. Cloud Consultant (Migrations and Modernisation)
e76075bf.description:
About Avashya
 
 Avashya is a new\-age, AI\-first, platform\-led services company, founded by engineers and specialists who spent years building at AWS and Microsoft. AI and our own platforms sit at the core of how we deliver, not bolted on around the edges. Cloud migration and modernisation is where a lot of that delivery starts: it's the work of moving a client off what's holding them back and onto something they can actually build on. This role owns that work end to end.
 



  




 The Opportunity
 
 You'll take enterprises off the infrastructure that's slowing them down and rebuild them to run faster, cheaper, and cleaner in the cloud. The clients are serious: some of the most demanding engineering estates around, the kind where a migration is never a lift\-and\-shift and the interesting problems only show up under real production load. You'll go deep on their systems, make the architecture calls that decide whether the move is a win or just a new bill, and own the result all the way to steady state. Depth over process. If you like taking hard, tangled systems and leaving them better than you found them, this is that job.
 



  




 What You'll Be Doing
 
**The platform** 



* Extend our migration and modernisation accelerators (assessment tooling, landing zone patterns, reusable infrastructure code), and when a client's estate breaks the template, get underneath it and build the pattern that handles it.
* Turn what you learn on one migration into something the next client inherits: a hardened reference architecture, a repeatable cutover runbook, a tested rollback path.



  





**The implementations** 



* Take a client's estate (a monolith, a fleet of on\-prem servers, a legacy data platform) and land it on the cloud as a working, production\-grade system, from discovery and dependency mapping through cutover and steady state.
* Choose the modernisation depth per workload: rehost where speed matters, replatform onto managed services, refactor to containers or serverless where the business case holds. Not a default playbook, the right call for the workload in front of you.
* Stay the owner after cutover. If it's live, you know why it costs what it costs and behaves the way it does.



  





**Tradeoffs and standards** 



* Different workloads want different tradeoffs: a big\-bang cutover for a self\-contained app, an incremental strangler approach for a system that can't take downtime. You make that call per client.
* Know what a workload is allowed to cost, in dollars and in latency, and hold that line through the move. A workload that lands slower or pricier than it started is a regression, not a win.
* Gate go\-live on measured validation, not a green dashboard: data integrity, performance parity, security posture, and cost against the pre\-migration baseline. When a cutover goes sideways, you find out why fast, with the rollback ready before you need it.
* Review architecture and code, and mentor as the team grows.



  




 Prerequisites
 
 NOT years of experience, depth. Here's what we'll go deep on:
 



  





**Architecture and migration strategy** 



* The 7 Rs in practice: not reciting them, but knowing where rehost buys speed, where replatform onto managed services pays off, and where a refactor to serverless or containers is worth the disruption.
* Cloud landing zones and multi\-account foundations: account structure, guardrails, network topology, hybrid connectivity, and where the well\-architected default fails a real estate.
* Discovery and dependency mapping: surfacing the undocumented, sequencing waves so dependencies move together, and planning cutovers that can actually roll back.
* Data migration under constraint: keeping data consistent and validated across a cutover without extended downtime.



  





**Modernisation, end to end** 



* Compute modernisation: containerising workloads, decomposing monoliths, and choosing serverless where it fits.
* Data and integration modernisation: moving off legacy databases and ETL onto managed and event\-driven patterns without breaking the systems that depend on them mid\-flight.
* Automation everywhere: infrastructure as code, CI/CD for infrastructure, and repeatable environment builds, so the second environment isn't hand\-crafted like the first.



  





**Cost, security, and validation** 



* Cost as a tracked outcome: right\-sizing, baselining against the source estate, and proving the migration is cheaper to run, not just landed.
* Security and compliance on a live migration: identity and access done properly, encryption in transit and at rest, network segmentation, and handling regulated data (HIPAA, GDPR, data residency) through the move, not after it.
* Migration validation: data integrity, performance parity, and security posture measured against the pre\-migration baseline before you call it done. P50/P95/P99 where latency matters, cost where it doesn't.



  




 Compensation
 
 Top\-of\-market. Pay reflects depth, not tenure.

N\-iX is a global software development service company that helps businesses across the globe create next\-generation software products. Our expertise spans cloud, data, AI/ML, embedded software, IoT, and more, driving digital transformation across finance, manufacturing, telecom, healthcare, and other industries. **Role Summary:**



As a Release Management contractor, you will be a release enabler for client's core services, coordinating cross\-team release activities across environments and products. You will own the operational lifecycle of releases \- from calendar planning and release readiness through execution, validation, and post\-release follow\-up \- ensuring changes ship safely, predictably, and in compliance with client's change\-management and audit standards.



You will partner closely with Engineering, SRE, the Operations Center, Incident Command, Security, and Product to minimize release risk while improving velocity and automation, acting as a primary contact for release status, blockers, and hot\-patch decisioning during your coverage window.


**Responsibilities****:**


* Coordinate release planning and calendars for core products.
* Run end\-to\-end release processes and weekly patches: track builds through environments, ensuring all gates and approvals are met before promotion.
* Own and facilitate Go/No\-Go processes for major releases occurring within the coverage window: prepare status, verify test results, highlight risks, and record Go/No\-Go outcomes and follow\-ups.
* Create and manage Release Authorizations (RA) and related artifacts to meet compliance and audit requirements.
* Partner with the DOC team to sequence and monitor deployments across regions and sites. Ensure pre\-deployment checks are completed, support troubleshooting of failed deployment jobs where RM is accountable.
* Enforce change\-management and business\-hours policies during off\-hours, including No\-Fly/moratorium periods, emergency change exceptions, and adherence to defined patch and hot\-patch criteria.
* Drive late\-merge and hot\-patch governance.
* Maintain and improve release observability: partner with Engineering/SRE to evolve RM dashboards, status views, and metrics showing release readiness, deployment progress, and risk across services and environments.
* Support post\-release quality by coordinating validation evidence.
* Support root\-cause and post\-mortem work for release\-related incidents and deployment regressions.
* Communicate clearly and proactively: provide concise release status, risk, and impact summaries to engineering leaders, incident commanders, and DOC, and ensure release email updates and stakeholder notifications are timely and accurate.


**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in Release Management, Program/Project Management, SRE/DevOps, or Technical Operations supporting production software releases.
* Experience managing multi\-environment release pipelines (e.g., development, demo, production, regulated environments) with formal gates and approvals.
* Hands\-on experience with Jira (or equivalent) for driving release epics/stories, change records, and cross\-team work tracking.
* Familiarity with CI/CD and deployment tooling such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GoCD, or equivalent release automation pipelines.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and change\-management controls (CAB, change types, rollback planning, audit evidence) in a SaaS or enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders (Engineering, SRE, Security, Product) under time pressure and drive to clear decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to summarize complex technical risk and status for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability and willingness to work the 7:00 PM – 4:00 AM PST coverage window reliably, acting as the primary Release Management contact during those hours.


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience running releases for large distributed systems or multi\-product platforms.
* Experience with observability and validation tooling such as Kusto, Grafana or equivalent for data\-driven Go/No\-Go decisions.
* Background in or close partnership with operations/SRE teams, including exposure to incident response and post\-mortem practices.
* Experience contributing to or leading release\-process transformation efforts (e.g., increased automation, dashboarding and metrics).
* Comfort working with SQL/DBA partners and understanding database deployment considerations as part of coordinated releases.

d6f0fbdb.description:
**Our Digital Transformation**
 The Coca Cola Company is evolving into a more digital first, data driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value. Rapid advances in technology, data, and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate the KO system’s next chapter of growth by reimagining our core competitive advantages. Building on a strong foundation of modernized infrastructure, global digital experiences, early data capabilities, and proven use cases, we are now shifting from early wins to scaled, end to end impact on growth, productivity, and efficiency. This next phase moves us from an analog world to a fully digitized one, powered by a digital growth engine that embeds data, technology, and AI into our most critical business domains. Success will require more than technology implementation, it demands a strategic transformation of core capabilities, a domain based, product centric operating model, and a cultural shift toward experimentation, data and technology fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Senior Manager, Technology Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the successful delivery, deployment, and operationalization of enterprise digital products across the Operating Unit. This role serves as the technical delivery leader, partnering with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure digital solutions are implemented, adopted, and optimized to deliver measurable business value. The role provides technical leadership throughout the product delivery lifecycle, overseeing solution implementation, market deployment, quality assurance, release management, and production readiness. Working closely with Global Digital Services, Operating Units, and bottling partners, the Technology Delivery Lead ensures global products are successfully localized where needed while maintaining alignment with enterprise architecture, engineering standards, and product roadmaps. Success in this role requires strong technical leadership, delivery management, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to bridge business priorities with engineering execution across a complex, global environment.
   

  

**What You Will Do For Us**
* Lead the end\-to\-end technical delivery and deployment of enterprise digital products across the Operating Unit.
* Provide technical leadership for regional product implementations, ensuring solutions align with enterprise architecture, engineering standards, and business objectives.
* Partner with Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical delivery plans and implementation roadmaps.
* Analyze local business needs and identify regional configuration, localization, and feature enhancement requirements to maximize product adoption.
* Coordinate engineering, quality assurance, infrastructure, and operations teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable digital solutions.
* Oversee product validation, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and quality assurance activities to ensure successful product releases.
* Lead release planning, deployment management, production readiness, and post\-launch stabilization activities.
* Identify and proactively manage delivery risks, technical dependencies, and implementation issues across multiple initiatives.
* Partner with Global Digital Services, Operating Units, bottlers, and business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery, adoption, and business value realization.
* Monitor delivery performance, operational health, service quality, and user feedback to drive continuous improvement.
* Support Agile delivery practices, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release coordination across cross\-functional teams.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, automation opportunities, and engineering best practices to improve delivery efficiency and operational excellence.


**ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT**
* Leads regional technology delivery for enterprise digital products that support strategic business priorities and transformation initiatives.
* Ensures consistent execution of delivery standards, quality practices, and release management processes across the Operating Unit.
* Improves product adoption, operational stability, and business value through effective implementation and stakeholder engagement.
* Partners with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, and business teams to accelerate successful product deployments.
* Influences delivery planning, implementation strategy, and operational readiness across multiple products and markets.
* Provides technical leadership to delivery teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.


**INNOVATION \& COMPLEXITY**
* Solves complex implementation and delivery challenges involving enterprise platforms, multiple stakeholders, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Balances global product standards with regional business needs to ensure scalable and effective deployments.
* Drives continuous improvement in delivery processes, quality assurance, release management, and operational support.
* Leverages automation, DevSecOps, AI\-assisted delivery tools, and modern engineering practices to improve delivery speed and reliability.
* Resolves technical and operational issues while maintaining focus on business outcomes and customer experience.


**COMMUNICATION \& INFLUENCE**
* Partners with Product Managers, Engineering leaders, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to align delivery priorities and execution plans.
* Communicates delivery status, implementation risks, dependencies, and business impacts to senior leadership.
* Facilitates cross\-functional planning sessions, release governance, and implementation reviews.
* Builds trusted relationships across Global Digital Services, Operating Units, bottlers, and external partners to drive successful implementations.
* Influences delivery decisions through technical expertise, structured problem\-solving, and a strong customer and business focus.


**Requirements And Qualifications Skills**
* 10–15\+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, digital transformation, program management, or enterprise technology leadership.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise digital products across multiple markets, business functions, or geographies.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile delivery, DevSecOps, quality assurance, and release management.
* Experience working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated success managing complex implementations, technical dependencies, and cross\-functional delivery teams.
* Experience leading testing, deployment, production readiness, and post\-implementation support activities.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, enterprise applications, APIs, integration patterns, and modern software delivery practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication, and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Experience within consumer products, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial, or global enterprise environments preferred.
* Expertise with Azure DevOps, Jira, Microsoft 365, project and portfolio management tools, and enterprise collaboration platforms.


**Candidate Profile**
 A collaborative technology delivery leader with deep experience implementing enterprise digital products, managing complex technical programs, and partnering across business and engineering organizations. Combines strong technical knowledge with operational discipline to deliver scalable solutions that improve business performance and accelerate digital transformation. Recognized for leading cross\-functional teams, navigating complex stakeholder environments, and consistently delivering high\-quality technology solutions that achieve measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 Budget Management, Communication, Data Analytics, DOT Regulations, Group Problem Solving, JDA (Inactive), Microsoft Office, Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (BI), Oracle Transportation Management, SAP Manufacturing Execution (SAP ME), Supply Chain, Tableau (Software), Transportation Logistics, Transportation Management Systems (TMS), Transportation Planning

 We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130\+ years. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner
* 3300\+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK \& Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description** **Role Overview**


We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead to lead the design, development, and delivery of a strategic Oracle APEX\-based solution supporting Procurement, Finance, and FP\&A business functions. The solution leverages Oracle APEX, Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW), and Oracle Fusion REST APIs to automate PO review, accrual management, audit compliance, and workflow automation. The Technical Lead will own architecture, technical governance, integration strategy, security design, and delivery oversight.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead end\-to\-end architecture and solution design.
* Define application, integration, database, and security architecture.
* Provide technical guidance to APEX developers and integration consultants.
* Establish development standards, code review processes, and deployment practices.
* Conduct architecture and design workshops with business stakeholders.

**Oracle APEX Solution Design**

* Design enterprise\-grade Oracle APEX applications.
* Define role\-based dashboards, reporting, workflow, and approval frameworks.
* Design reusable components and development standards.
* Drive performance optimization and scalability initiatives.

**Oracle Fusion Integration**

* Lead Oracle Fusion REST API integration strategy.
* Design secure integration patterns between Oracle Fusion and APEX.
* Oversee API authentication, error handling, monitoring, and exception management.
* Ensure seamless integration with Procurement, AP, Finance, and related modules.

**Database \& Data Architecture**

* Design ADW data models and reporting structures.
* Define audit trail framework and historical data retention strategy.
* Implement performance tuning and data optimization measures.
* Ensure data security and regulatory compliance.

**Governance \& Compliance**

* Ensure SOX\-compliant design and auditability.
* Implement Segregation of Duties (SoD) controls.
* Design immutable audit trails and controlled access models.
* Support internal audit reviews and compliance assessments.

**Delivery \& Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Project Managers, Functional Consultants, and Business SMEs.
* Participate in requirement workshops, design reviews, SIT, UAT, and go\-live activities.
* Manage technical risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Provide executive\-level technical updates and recommendation papers.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Skills**

**Technical Skills**

* Oracle APEX (Version 21\.x and above preferred)
* Oracle Database / PL/SQL
* Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW)
* Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP
* Oracle Fusion REST APIs
* SQL Performance Tuning
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
* Web Services (REST/JSON)
* Git / Source Control
* Application Security \& RBAC

**Functional Knowledge**

* Procurement
* Purchase Orders
* Accrual Processes
* AP \& Financial Close
* Approval Workflows
* Audit \& Compliance Controls

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle APEX Developer Professional Certification
* Oracle Cloud Certifications
* TOGAF or equivalent Architecture Certification
* Experience in regulated industries (Life Sciences, Healthcare, Financial Services)

**Nice to Have**

* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
* BI Publisher / OTBI
* Agile/Scrum delivery
* DevOps and CI/CD implementation

  

**Additional Information** **Why Version 1?**


 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies

At Western Union, we’re more than a trusted name in global payments. We’re moving beyond remittances, beyond cash, and beyond the expectations of our customers.  


Our talented teams enable us to transform into a digital\-first company, built on the strength of our retail foundation and powered by next\-generation payments. All this with the goal of helping people prosper.

Role Responsibilities  


As a Solution Architect, DevOps \& Release Management, within the Risk and Compliance team based in Pune,. You will play a critical role in driving the DevOps and platform engineering adoption across the Risk \& Compliance technology ecosystem. You will partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Product, and Enterprise Architecture teams to modernize CI/CD capabilities, advance Infrastructure\-as\-Code adoption, strengthen observability and operational readiness, and establish best\-in\-class release management practices. Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment speed, quality, and reliability.  
Define release governance, deployment standards, rollback strategies, and environment management processes.  
Architect scalable, secure, and highly available AWS and hybrid\-cloud solutions.  
Design and Develop Infrastructure\-as\-Code using Terraform and cloud automation frameworks.  
configuration management and environment automation using Ansible.

Proactively identify technical risks, remove delivery impediments, and provide scalable solutions to complex engineering challenges.  
You will provide technical leadership for platform automation initiatives, drive continuous improvement across release and deployment processes, and champion engineering excellence through standardization, innovation, and automation. 13ce9738.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
13ce9738.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Lead Technical Program Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 Are you a technical program manager who wants to shape the cloud platform for Mastercard’s products? Do you want to work for a company that offers above and beyond benefits including paid parental leave, flexible work hours, gift matching, and even volunteer incentives? Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your own professional learning and development?
   

  

 ROLE
   

  

 We are breaking up our monoliths and re\-platforming features into re\-usable micro\-services and APIs while we continue to innovate and deliver results for our customers. All net new capabilities will be built on the cloud platform supporting multi\-tenancy and multi\-geography capabilities for the company. We are looking for experienced technical program management professionals to join our team and help us build towards the future. Our Technical Program Managers (TPM) conceptualize, rationalize, and drive multiple simultaneous projects to deliver engineering work across the portfolio in our scrum execution model. In this role, you get to dive as deep as you want into the tech stack, the integration patterns, the organizational capabilities, and the company wide assets that can be leveraged to provide technical solutions to customer problems. You will contribute to the strategies, design choices, and even the cloud infrastructure necessary to build comprehensive believable and achievable execution plans to deliver high\-profile new features and capabilities for our customers. You may drive the execution of a feature through the full stack or may drive a project which spans multiple teams and integrations, reporting meaningful status along the way.
   

  

**All About You**
 Demonstrated ability to operate with independence and autonomy
   

  

 Experience defining and building cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale with a deep understanding of those platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
   

  

 Experience working on programs to define and build cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale
   

  

 Enjoys diving deep to understand of the platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
   

  

 Proven track record of data driven decision\-making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
   

  

 Can debate the delivery strategy with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers
   

  

 Can communicate to executives, peers, and staff with impact, eloquence, and authenticity
   

  

 Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
   

  

 Huge plus if you have expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, serverless technology, CI/CD, NoSQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model
   

  

 BS in engineering, computer science or related discipline.
   

  

 Technical program delivery experience including time developing and testing software
   

  

 AI related adoption in program management is a must
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to join our CIO/PMO organization at a pivotal moment, as we accelerate an enterprise\-wide AI transformation. This is not a conventional program management role. You will sit at the intersection of strategy, governance, and execution, shaping how critical transformative programs are run. Reporting into the Director, Technical Program Manager, you will be a key voice in building the PMO function and driving transformation across CIO Organization.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO** :


* Partner directly with the CIO and his leadership team on critical transformation program strategy and delivery
* Build and run program governance structures that scale with Tekion's hyper growth
* Establish and continuously improve sprint cadence, story point estimation, Definition of Done, milestone tracking etc.
* Identify and proactively manage risks, blockers, and escalation paths across complex, multi\-team programs
* Drive structured program rollouts with defined scope, success metrics, and dependency management
* Produce C\-suite facing deliverables: program status decks, OKR scorecards, quarterly business narratives, and business proposals
* Define and track PMO KPIs: delivery velocity, capacity utilization, and quality indicators
* Build and maintain dashboards in Jira, Confluence, and other AI tools for real\-time program visibility
* Champion PMO maturity across teams\- standardizing processes, governance frameworks, and reporting cadences


 **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** :


* 7\+ years of technical program management experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex, cross\-functional technical programs
* 2\-4 years of management consulting experience preferred at a recognized firm, with strong executive\-facing communication and structured problem\-solving skills
* Prior experience embedded in a PMO within a multinational company, you have operated across geographies, time zones, and cross functional teams
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to present to senior leadership team
* Proven track record delivering programs in enterprise technology environments (GTM, Finance, Data/AI, or similar)
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Agile/PDLC delivery frameworks
* Well versed with AI LLM models and building skills/agents
**About the company**
---------------------


Tekion is redefining automotive retail with an end\-to\-end, AI\-native platform purpose\-built for the industry. With AI built into every workflow, Tekion delivers intelligent automation, real\-time insights, and advanced decision support—driving measurable efficiency, revenue, and modern consumer.

Program Management, program development


### **Good\-to\-have skills**



Jira, Confluence, Artificial Intelligence

f0e4217e.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
f0e4217e.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead Technical Program Manager
OVERVIEW  

Are you a technical program manager who wants to shape the cloud platform for Mastercard’s products? Do you want to work for a company that offers above and beyond benefits including paid parental leave, flexible work hours, gift matching, and even volunteer incentives? Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your own professional learning and development?  

  

ROLE  

We are breaking up our monoliths and re\-platforming features into re\-usable micro\-services and APIs while we continue to innovate and deliver results for our customers. All net new capabilities will be built on the cloud platform supporting multi\-tenancy and multi\-geography capabilities for the company. We are looking for experienced technical program management professionals to join our team and help us build towards the future. Our Technical Program Managers (TPM) conceptualize, rationalize, and drive multiple simultaneous projects to deliver engineering work across the portfolio in our scrum execution model. In this role, you get to dive as deep as you want into the tech stack, the integration patterns, the organizational capabilities, and the company wide assets that can be leveraged to provide technical solutions to customer problems. You will contribute to the strategies, design choices, and even the cloud infrastructure necessary to build comprehensive believable and achievable execution plans to deliver high\-profile new features and capabilities for our customers. You may drive the execution of a feature through the full stack or may drive a project which spans multiple teams and integrations, reporting meaningful status along the way.
  

  

ALL ABOUT YOU  

Demonstrated ability to operate with independence and autonomy
  

Experience defining and building cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale with a deep understanding of those platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.  

Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)  

Experience working on programs to define and build cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale  

Enjoys diving deep to understand of the platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
  

Proven track record of data driven decision\-making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
  

Can debate the delivery strategy with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers
  

Can communicate to executives, peers, and staff with impact, eloquence, and authenticity  

Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization  

Huge plus if you have expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, serverless technology, CI/CD, NoSQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model  

BS in engineering, computer science or related discipline.
  

Technical program delivery experience including time developing and testing software  

AI related adoption in program management is a must **Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

53bf8952.title: Solution Engineer
53bf8952.description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75\+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
   

  

 As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full\-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
   

  

 We operate with an AI\-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
   

  

 If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
   

  

 Let’s build what’s next, together.
   

  

 As a Solution Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, demonstrating, and implementing enterprise\-level SaaS, chatbot, conversational AI, and CPaaS solutions for clients. This is a highly client\-facing role that combines strong communication and consultative skills with hands\-on technical execution.
   

  

 You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements, define the scope of work, conduct solution reviews, and deliver customized solutions using APIs, conversational AI, automation platforms, and emerging AI development tools.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is confident in customer interactions, able to convince and influence stakeholders, and comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, and reusable technical artifacts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement chatbot, conversational agent, and AI\-powered solutions tailored to client requirements.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their business challenges, explain technical concepts, present solutions, and build confidence in the proposed approach.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions, solution reviews, feasibility analyses, product demonstrations, and proof\-of\-concept discussions.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions, implementation plans, and scopes of work.
* Use AI development tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar AI platforms to accelerate solution design, implementation, coding, prototyping, and documentation.
* Create and maintain AI\-generated or AI\-assisted technical artifacts, including prototypes, workflows, reusable skills, integrations, code components, documentation, and solution accelerators.
* Integrate and configure CPaaS products, including: Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, Marketing automation solutions, Conversational agent and chatbot platforms
* Utilize REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and other integration capabilities to extend solution functionality.
* Work with JavaScript, C\+\+, .NET, and related technologies to customize and integrate client solutions.
* Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success teams to define client needs, solution scope, effort estimates, dependencies, and delivery expectations.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess feasibility, resolve technical issues, and provide client feedback.
* Support solution implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation troubleshooting.
* Provide ongoing technical consulting and post\-implementation support to ensure client satisfaction and optimal solution performance.
* Stay up to date with SaaS, conversational AI, generative AI, automation, and CPaaS trends, and apply relevant best practices.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, best\-practice documentation, technical mentorship, and the development of reusable solution assets.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in solution engineering, technical consulting, systems development, enterprise software implementation, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience in a customer\-facing role, including the ability to communicate confidently, present solutions, influence stakeholders, and handle client discussions independently.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, workflows, or other technical artifacts.
* Practical experience with chatbot technologies, conversational AI, generative AI, or conversational agent solutions.
* Proficiency in one or more of JavaScript, C\+\+, and .NET, along with the ability to understand and work across multiple technologies.
* Strong knowledge of API integrations, particularly REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and third\-party service integrations.
* Experience with SaaS products and enterprise\-level implementations.
* Familiarity with CPaaS products such as Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with Agile methodologies is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Why you'll love it here**
* Financial rewards \& recognition \- A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance\-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements \- We combine in\-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere \- and not always between 9 and 5\.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) \- As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work\-life balance and Well\-being  \- We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility \- Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development \- Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow \- no matter where you start.
* International mobility \- Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long\-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well\-being, and success \- wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection


**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** 
 We’re proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
   

  

 No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
   

  

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
 Read more about our hiring process.
