519f6acd.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with one or more general purpose programming languages like Java, Python, Go.
* 2 years of experience building AI solutions and experiences.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in generative AI agent and machine learning.
* Experience in full\-stack development, enterprise software architecture and AI platforms.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



Within Google Cloud, Looker is the core of our Business Intelligence (BI) and analytics platform. Our mission is to reinvent BI by moving it from a descriptive (what happened) tool to a prescriptive and collaborative partner (what should we do next?). We are doing this by deeply infusing Generative AI into the Looker platform. We believe this is a 100x opportunity to change how the world interacts with data. This role is central to that mission, defining how we leverage Looker's unique semantic layer to provide trusted, governed, and conversational data experiences to everyone.

  

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Dive deep into the core Artificial Intelligence (AI) and BI use cases and build easy\-to\-use and scalable features. Build a robust and scalable systems.
* Collaborate with a team of engineers to develop techniques that improve system performance, efficiency, and scalability.
* Drive end\-to\-end ownership of critical components, from design and implementation to testing and optimization.
* Be an expert in BI domain. Foster an environment of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.
* Define key tech improvements, driving progress through innovation. Collaborate with cross\-functional, cross\-geo teams and stakeholders.

eff7f879.title: Solution Architect - MCS (Managed Collaboration Services)
eff7f879.description:
Solution Architect \- MCS (Managed Collaboration Services)
**Description \-**

Role Summary


Applies advanced subject matter expertise to design, develop, and position technology solutions that address customer business and technical requirements. Works independently on opportunities of varying complexity, partnering with Sales, Delivery, and cross\-functional teams to deliver commercially viable and customer\-focused solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Opportunity Analysis**

* Partner with Sales teams to understand customer business objectives, technical requirements, and strategic priorities.
* Assess customer needs and align them with HP solutions and services.
* Analyze competitive positioning, customer budgets, and commercial requirements to support winning deal strategies.

### **Solution Design \& Development**

* Design scalable, cost\-effective solutions that meet customer business and technical requirements.

738a8569.description:
**Department:** 
 Product Development

 India \- Resident (0008\)

 ₹3,825,000 \- ₹5,175,000 / year
   

  

**Description**
**This role will be working out of our Pune or Indore office 5 days a week.**
 Vena Solutions is hiring a Solution Architect, Product \& Technology (Acterys), to help shape and evolve the architecture of the Acterys application within Vena’s growing SaaS platform. In this role, you’ll take ownership of the solution architecture for new and existing capabilities, working closely with product and engineering partners to turn business needs into secure, scalable, resilient, and high‑quality solutions.
   

  

 You’ll bring strong experience designing cloud‑based applications and data‑rich integrated systems, with a thoughtful approach to non‑functional requirements such as performance, security, reliability, and data integrity. As part of your day‑to‑day work, you’ll use AI‑assisted tools to support architectural analysis, accelerate design exploration, assess impacts, and improve documentation, while applying sound judgment and clear accountability to architectural decisions.
   

  

 Collaboration is central to this role. You’ll work alongside teams across Product, Engineering, CloudOps, Infrastructure, and Security to guide solutions from early design through delivery and evolution. You’ll also help teams adopt AI in practical, responsible ways, ensuring solutions are transparent, well‑governed, and aligned with customer trust and compliance expectations.
   

  

 At Vena, innovation is driven by a relentless focus on customer outcomes and continuous improvement. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy solving complex problems, working in a fast‑moving SaaS environment, and having a visible impact on both the product and the people building it.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
**Solution Architecture, Strategy \& Delivery:**
* Partner with Product Management and domain experts to define, own, and evolve the solution architecture and roadmap for a set of Acterys features and capabilities within a cloud‑based SaaS environment.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering teams to define pragmatic, well‑reasoned solution designs that balance functional needs with performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Review and validate engineering designs and implementations to ensure alignment with approved solution architecture, architectural standards, and compliance requirements.
* Support delivery teams throughout the delivery lifecycle by helping resolve complex technical challenges, guiding refactoring efforts, and improving solution quality as requirements and constraints evolve.


**Research \& Continuous Improvement:**
* Stay informed of relevant industry trends, technologies, and architectural practices, evaluating opportunities to evolve solution patterns, blueprints, and delivery approaches.
* Leverage modern tooling, including AI‑assisted research and analysis, to support informed architectural decisions and continuous improvement. Architecture Communication \& Enablement:
* Maintain clear, accurate architecture artifacts and decision records, ensuring solutions are well understood and traceable across stakeholders.
* Proactively communicate architectural decisions and changes, while mentoring and supporting engineers through design reviews, working sessions, and ongoing knowledge sharing. Architecture Governance:
* Actively participate in architecture governance, contributing to the definition and application of standards, principles, policies, and best practices.
* Help ensure architectural decisions are consistent, well‑reasoned, and aligned with platform strategy, compliance expectations, and long‑term sustainability. Innovation \& Proof of Concept:
* Collaborate with cross‑functional stakeholders on proof‑of‑concept initiatives to explore new capabilities and support business cases for future features and enhancements.
* Contribute to a culture of innovation by helping teams experiment responsibly while maintaining architectural quality and customer trust.


**We'd Love to See**
* 2\+ years’ experience in applied Solution Architecture, 12\+ years’ experience in software development
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure with a focus on Microsoft SQL Server and/or Azure SQL Server
* Good knowledge of relational databases/OLTP and SQL language for reporting, including knowledge of TSQL and procedural SQL
* Good understanding of Data Warehousing key concepts:
* Star Schema (Dimensions, Fact tables, Measures)
* Familiarity with ETL for DWs
* Strengths and weaknesses of DWs
* Good knowledge of Power BI technology stack:
* Familiar with DAX and M
* Familiar with building Power BI Models
* Prior experience with financial systems and reports
* P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow reports
* Prior experience with financial systems, CPM, ERPs, cloud\-based accounting systems (Xero, QuickBooks, etc.) highly regarded
* Experience in designing distributed and concurrent systems and microservices and APIs (REST, GraphQL)
* Knowledge of and experience with development of cloud\-based SaaS applications
* Proven collaboration, communication and influencing skills across diverse stakeholders
* Working knowledge of Angular and Typescript is beneficial
* Interest in AI and willingness to explore AI\-driven solutions to enhance performance and drive efficiencies
* Our salaries are tailored to roles, levels and locations. Your individual pay within this range is influenced by factors like work location, skills, experience and education. As you progress in your role, your compensation may adapt, offering flexibility for growth beyond initial levels. For specifics, your recruiter will provide details and address any questions during the hiring process.

Job Details
**1\. Role Summary** – BHIVE Group is looking for a Program Manager to plan, coordinate and deliver IT programs spanning infrastructure and network, cybersecurity, and ERP implementation. This is a program\-management role, not a technical specialist role — the focus is on driving delivery, not building solutions hands\-on. The successful candidate leads through people and process: orchestrating internal teams, vendors and stakeholders to deliver programs on time, within budget, and in line with BHIVE’s IT policies, SOPs and governance standards.


A working understanding of the IT domains involved is sufficient — enough to converse credibly with technical teams and vendors, ask the right questions, and make informed prioritisation and risk decisions. Deep, hands\-on expertise in networking, security or ERP configuration is not required; strong program\-management discipline is.


**2\. Key Responsibilities**


**Program Planning \& Delivery**


* Own end\-to\-end delivery of IT programs across infrastructure, network, cybersecurity and ERP — defining scope, schedule, budget, resourcing and success criteria.
* Build and maintain integrated program plans, milestones and roadmaps across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Drive execution to agreed timelines and budgets; proactively remove blockers and manage change requests through to sign\-off.
* Coordinate cutovers, go\-lives and rollouts across BHIVE sites, ensuring readiness and clean hand\-over to operations / support.

**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**


* Act as the single point of coordination between business owners (Finance, HR, Operations), internal IT teams, and external vendors / system integrators.
* Manage vendor engagement — RFPs, SOWs, deliverables, SLAs and performance — and hold partners accountable to commitments.
* Run steering committees and status reviews; communicate progress, risks and decisions clearly to leadership and stakeholders.

**Risk, Budget \& Reporting**


* Maintain RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and drive timely mitigation and escalation.
* Track program budgets and spend against approved plans; flag variances early and support forecasting.
* Produce dashboards and reports on program health, KPIs and milestones for the SVP – IT and leadership.

**Governance, Policies \& Documentation**


* Develop, maintain and enforce IT policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and process documentation across programs.
* Establish and run governance routines — change management, access reviews, asset and license/subscription governance, and vendor governance.
* Maintain an audit\-ready documentation repository (SharePoint) and support internal and external audits and compliance requirements.
* Ensure every program adheres to security and governance controls from initiation through closure.

**3\. Program Management Skills \& Competencies**


* **Planning:** Planning \& scheduling — building realistic plans, critical\-path and dependency management across parallel workstreams.
* **Stakeholders:** Stakeholder management — aligning cross\-functional teams, managing expectations and communicating with clarity at all levels.
* **Vendors:** Vendor \& contract management — RFPs, SOWs, negotiations, SLAs and holding partners to account.
* **Risk:** Risk \& issue management — identifying, quantifying, escalating and mitigating risks before they impact delivery.
* **Budget:** Budget \& financial tracking — cost control, forecasting and variance management.
* **Governance:** Governance \& documentation — policies, SOPs, audit readiness and disciplined record\-keeping.
* **Methods:** Methodologies \& tools — Waterfall / Agile / hybrid delivery; fluency with project\-tracking, reporting and collaboration tools.
* **Leadership:** Communication \& leadership — steering committees, status reporting, and influencing without authority.

**4\. Required Qualifications**


* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (IT / Engineering / Management preferred).
* **Experience:** 5\+ years in program / project management, ideally delivering IT or technology\-enabled programs.
* **Delivery:** Proven track record delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
* **IT knowledge:** Working (not expert) understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity and ERP concepts — enough to lead technical teams and vendors effectively.
* **Governance:** Experience authoring policies, SOPs and governance documentation; comfortable in audit and compliance environments.
* **Soft skills:** Excellent communication, coordination, stakeholder\-management and documentation skills.

**5\. Preferred / Good to Have**


* Program / project management certification — PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, or Agile / Scrum (CSM, PSM).
* Exposure to ITIL, or governance frameworks such as ISO 27001, in a coordination capacity.
* Familiarity with ZOHO, Microsoft 365, SharePoint and project\-tracking tools.
* Prior experience in coworking, real estate, or multi\-site / high\-growth environments.

94bb3f68.title: Cybersecurity Architect
94bb3f68.description:
**Company Description**  

Every minute of every day, Smiths Detection’s threat detection and security screening technology helps to protect people and infrastructure, making the world a safer place.


Smiths Detection is a global leader in the development, manufacture and management of security and detection solutions designed to make the world a safer place. Our technology provides threat detection and screening solutions for customers in our key markets: aviation, ports and borders, defence, and urban security.


Our expertise spans 21 global offices, seven manufacturing sites and five R\&D centres, with a global network of 3,500 dedicated colleagues contributing towards over 40 years at the frontline of advances in safety and security.


This results in careers built on variety and the opportunity to work on a range of state\-of\-the\-art solutions, where you can develop your knowledge and experience every day.

 **Job Description**  

Job Purpose


We are seeking an experienced **Cybersecurity Architect** to drive the design, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise security architecture across cloud, infrastructure, SaaS, and corporate technology environments.


Partnering closely with Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering, and Digital teams, you will play a critical role in ensuring security is embedded into technology solutions, business initiatives, and digital transformation programs. You will provide strategic security guidance while balancing business objectives, regulatory requirements, and cyber risk.


Key Responsibilities

* Define and maintain enterprise cybersecurity architecture principles, standards, patterns, and reference architectures.
* Design and review secure solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
* Conduct security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and threat modelling for new applications, cloud platforms, SaaS solutions, and technology initiatives.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering, and Product teams to ensure security is embedded throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Evaluate and recommend security controls aligned with business, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
* Assess third\-party vendors and SaaS platforms for security, compliance, and risk considerations.
* Design and advise on Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Microsoft Entra ID, and Zero Trust solutions.
* Establish cloud security guardrails covering identity, network security, data protection, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
* Provide security architecture guidance across endpoint security, data protection, and security operations capabilities.
* Stay ahead of emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends to strengthen the organization's security posture.

 **Qualifications**  

What You'll Bring

* Proven experience in Cybersecurity Architecture, Security Engineering, or Security Consulting roles.
* Strong expertise in cloud security architecture across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
* Experience conducting security reviews, architecture assessments, threat modelling, and risk analysis.
* Deep understanding of:
	+ Identity \& Access Management (IAM)
	+ Privileged Access Management (PAM)
	+ Microsoft Entra ID
	+ Zero Trust Architecture
	+ Network Security \& Segmentation
	+ Endpoint Security \& Data Protection
	+ Security Controls \& Risk Management
	+ Secure Development and DevSecOps practices
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate technical security risks into business\-focused recommendations.


Preferred Certifications

* CISSP
* CCSP
* TOGAF

  

**Additional Information**  

Join us and we’ll help build your career, with excellent training and opportunities for career growth across the business, both locally and globally. You’ll experience an inclusive environment, with strong leadership and a focus on safety and wellbeing. You’ll also have the flexibility to choose from a wide range of benefits to suit your lifestyle, offering you and your family support from a health and wellbeing, financial and lifestyle perspective.

**Join us and work for a world\-leader, with the benefits and training to reward your dedication and skills. Be part of a team where we are making the world a safer place.**


We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity.


At no time during the hiring process will Smiths Detection, nor any of our recruitment partners ever request payment to enable participation – including, but not limited to, interviews or testing. Avoid fraudulent requests by applying jobs directly through our career’s website.

1\. ITSM (IT Service Management): Configure and enhance core ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management. Develop custom workflows, automation, and integrations to improve IT service delivery. Collaborate with service owners to optimize user experience and process efficiency.  

2\. ITOM (IT Operations Management): Implement and optimize ITOM capabilities, including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Orchestration. Enhance monitoring, alerting, and automated responses to improve service uptime and operational resilience. Ensure secure, scalable, and reliable integrations that facilitate seamless data exchange across platforms. Troubleshoot integration issues and monitor performance to ensure minimal downtime.

. Experience: 12 \- 15 years of experience in ServiceNow Solution design, implementation, development and administration, with a deep understanding of multiple modules.  

. Certifications: Preferred certifications include ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (for ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, GRC), and experience with Integration Hub.

**Our Digital Transformation**


The Coca Cola Company is evolving into a more digital first, data driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value. Rapid advances in technology, data, and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate The Coca\-Cola Company (TCCC) system’s next chapter of growth by reimagining our core competitive advantages. Building on a strong foundation of modernized infrastructure, global digital experiences, early data capabilities, and proven use cases, we are now shifting from early wins to scaled, end to end impact on growth, productivity, and efficiency. This next phase moves us from an analog world to a fully digitized one, powered by a digital growth engine that embeds data, technology, and AI into our most critical business domains. Success will require more than technology implementation, it demands a strategic transformation of core capabilities, a domain based, product centric operating model, and a cultural shift toward experimentation, data and technology fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams.

**Role Overview**


The Senior Manager, Technology Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the successful delivery, deployment, and operationalization of enterprise digital products across the Operating Unit. This role serves as the technical delivery leader, partnering with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure digital solutions are implemented, adopted, and optimized to deliver measurable business value. The role provides technical leadership throughout the product delivery lifecycle, overseeing solution implementation, market deployment, quality assurance, release management, and production readiness. Working closely with Global Digital Services, Operating Units, and bottling partners, the Technology Delivery Lead ensures global products are successfully localized where needed while maintaining alignment with enterprise architecture, engineering standards, and product roadmaps. Success in this role requires strong technical leadership, delivery management, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to bridge business priorities with engineering execution across a complex, global environment.

* Partner with Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical delivery plans and implementation roadmaps.

60939101.title: Java Solution Architect with Azure
60939101.description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Job Description**


We are seeking an experienced **Java Solution Architect** to lead the **re\-platforming and modernization** of mission\-critical **IBM DB2/Mainframe applications** onto **Microsoft Azure**. The role will drive target\-state architecture, application modernization, cloud\-native design, integration strategies, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code standards while ensuring scalable, secure, resilient, and business\-aligned solutions.


The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in **Java enterprise application architecture, Azure cloud platforms, legacy modernization, microservices transformation, and large\-scale re\-platforming initiatives**, with a proven track record of migrating monolithic and mainframe\-based systems to modern cloud\-native architectures.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Application Modernization \& Re\-platforming**

* Define the target architecture and modernization roadmap for migrating Mainframe/DB2 applications to Azure.
* Lead re\-platforming initiatives transforming legacy applications into cloud\-native, microservices\-based architectures.
* Define modernization patterns including decomposition, service extraction, API enablement, and event\-driven architectures.
* Balance business continuity, risk, scalability, cost, and operational efficiency during transformation programs.

**Java \& Microservices Architecture**

* Design enterprise\-grade solutions using **Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Spring Cloud, and RESTful APIs**.
* Define microservices architecture standards, domain boundaries, integration contracts, and service governance.
* Architect batch, real\-time, and event\-driven processing solutions.
* Design reusable frameworks, shared services, and engineering standards to accelerate modernization efforts.
* Establish best practices for application scalability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and performance optimization.

**Azure Cloud Architecture**

* Architect cloud\-native solutions leveraging Azure services including:
	+ AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service) and Docker
	+ Azure Functions
	+ API Management
	+ Azure Data Factory
	+ Event Hub / Service Bus
	+ Azure Storage Services
* Design **hybrid integration patterns between mainframe and Azure environments**.
* Establish cloud architecture standards covering security, scalability, observability, and operational excellence.

**DevOps, Automation \& Infrastructure**

* Define and implement **Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform (Mandatory)**.
* Working knowledge of integrating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
* Establish DevSecOps practices including automated testing, security scanning, deployment automation, and monitoring.
* Drive cloud cost optimization and operational efficiency initiatives.

**Technology Leadership \& AI Adoption**

* Provide architecture leadership, governance, and technical direction across modernization programs.
* Conduct architecture reviews, design assessments, and technology evaluations.
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted software engineering and architecture practices.
* Evaluate and integrate AI/GenAI capabilities to improve developer productivity, operational automation, and business outcomes.
* Ensure responsible, secure, and compliant adoption of AI technologies.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **14\+ years of experience** in Solution Architecture, Application Architecture, or Enterprise Architecture.
* **Strong experience leading large\-scale application re\-platforming and modernization programs.**
* Expert\-level experience in:
	+ Java 21
	+ Spring Boot
	+ Spring Batch
	+ Spring Cloud
	+ Microservices Architecture
	+ API Design \& Integration
* Extensive experience migrating applications from:
	+ Monolithic to Microservices
	+ On\-Premises to Azure
* Deep expertise in Azure cloud architecture and platform services.
* Hands\-on expertise with **Terraform (Mandatory)** and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Strong experience with:
	+ Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions
	+ Kubernetes (AKS preferred) and Docker
	+ CI/CD Architecture
	+ DevSecOps
* Experience with:
	+ Event\-driven architectures
	+ Kafka / Event Hub
	+ Service Bus
	+ CDC and Data Synchronization
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, resiliency, and cloud\-native design patterns.
* Experience working with DB2, PostgreSQL, and enterprise data integration patterns.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging AI/GenAI technologies in software engineering, architecture, or modernization initiatives.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  



  

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

  

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues customers face in their data and AI stack, from Kubernetes orchestration to pipeline performance
* Identify opportunities to expand Shakudo's footprint within existing accounts by connecting customer needs to platform capabilities

* Collaborate with Customer Engineering to ensure smooth hand\-offs and consistent solution quality
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases, solution patterns, and best practices that accelerate delivery across the team



  





**Qualifications** 



* 4–8 years of experience in solution engineering, solution architecture, or a senior engineering role with significant client\-facing responsibility
* Strong Kubernetes and Helm Chart development and deployment experience
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code

* Prior experience in a Solutions Architect or Solutions Engineer role at a B2B infrastructure or platform company
* Familiarity with the open\-source data and AI ecosystem (dbt, Airflow, MLflow, etc.)



  





**Why Shakudo Stands Out** 




  




* Work with cutting\-edge technologies in machine learning and high\-performance computing
* Contribute to a platform that transforms how organizations leverage data and AI
* Join a dynamic team that values innovation, efficiency, and diversity



  





  





 This is a work from office role based out of Bangalore (HSR Layout). Shakudo has offices in Toronto, San Francisco, and Bangalore.

Once opportunities move to post\-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands\-on coding to build proofs\-of\-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility.
 



 As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross\-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain\-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent\-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.
 



  





 This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands\-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre\-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real\-world business impact.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* **Customer\-facing:** 
 20\-40% working directly with customers
* **Design \& Deploy AI Agents** 
 : Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems.
* **Integrate Systems** 
 : Connect AI agents with external platforms (e.g., CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation.
* **Optimize Performance** 
 : Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* **Own Requirements** 
 : Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications.
* **Prototype \& Iterate** 
 : Lead live demos, build rapid proof\-of\-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback.
* **Lead Execution** 
 : Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments.
* **Advise Customers** 
 : Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long\-term scalability.



  





**What You Bring:** 



* **Experience** 
 : 10\+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer\-facing experience is a plus.
* **Background** 
 : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* **Coding Skills:** 
 Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go).
* **Applied AI Knowledge:** 
 Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* **Cloud \& DevOps** 
 : Hands\-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* **System Integration** 
 : Comfortable integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and event/data pipelines.
* **Data\-Driven Mindset** 
 : Use A/B testing, telemetry, and metrics to guide decisions and drive improvements.
* **Communication** 
 : Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders.
* **Customer Empathy** 
 : A bias for action and a relentless focus on solving problems for customers.
* **Education** 
 : Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.



  





 As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.

**IT Infrastructure \& Azure Cloud AMS Manager**

 Full\-Time

 10\+ Years

 Microsoft Azure
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced and highly hands\-on
 **IT Infrastructure \& Azure Cloud AMS Manager** 
 to lead our Infrastructure and Cloud Application/Managed Services (AMS) operations.

 **technical leadership, client\-facing, and service delivery role** 
 . The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the Infrastructure AMS team, maintaining strong client relationships, ensuring SLA\-driven service delivery, and remaining technically hands\-on when complex infrastructure or cloud issues require senior\-level involvement.

 **traditional enterprise infrastructure and Microsoft Azure environments**

**Client Management \& Customer Interaction** 



* Serve as the primary operational and technical point of contact for assigned clients.

* VPN Gateway
* ExpressRoute
* Azure Storage

* Azure cost optimization and FinOps

**Traditional Enterprise Infrastructure** 




 Strong hands\-on experience with:
 


* Windows Server
* Active Directory
* Group Policy
* DNS and DHCP
* Microsoft IIS
* VMware and virtualization technologies
* Physical and virtual servers
* SAN/NAS and enterprise storage
* Backup and recovery platforms
* File servers
* Server patching
* Data center infrastructure
* Infrastructure migrations and upgrades
* Hardware and operating system troubleshooting
* Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity



**Networking** 




 Strong understanding of:
 


* TCP/IP
* Routing and switching
* VLANs
* DNS
* DHCP
* VPN
* Firewalls
* Load balancers
* Site\-to\-site connectivity
* Azure networking
* Hybrid cloud connectivity
* Network troubleshooting



**Infrastructure Security \& Vulnerability Management** 




 Responsible for driving:
 


* Infrastructure hardening
* Vulnerability remediation
* Server patch management
* Identity and access management
* Privileged access management
* Firewall and network security
* SSL/TLS certificate management
* Backup security
* Disaster Recovery
* Security monitoring and remediation



 Experience with technologies such as
 **Tenable, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, or similar platforms** 
 is preferred.
 



**Monitoring, Incident \& Service Management** 



* Manage infrastructure monitoring and alerting.
* Own major incident management and escalation.
* Lead technical bridge calls during critical production incidents.
* Coordinate across infrastructure, network, security, application, database, and cloud teams.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Track SLA, MTTR, incident trends, availability, capacity, vulnerabilities, and operational health.
* Develop monthly client service reports and executive\-level operational summaries.
* Identify recurring problems and eliminate them through automation or architectural improvements.



**Automation \& AI\-Driven Operations** 




 Drive infrastructure automation using technologies such as:
 


* PowerShell
* Azure CLI
* Terraform
* ARM/Bicep
* Infrastructure as Code
* Automated patching
* Automated monitoring
* Automated remediation



 The manager should continuously identify opportunities to introduce
 **automation, AIOps, proactive monitoring, and self\-healing capabilities** 
 into the AMS environment.
 



**Required Experience** 



* 10\+ years of IT Infrastructure experience.
* 3\+ years in an Infrastructure Manager, AMS Manager, Cloud Operations Manager, Service Delivery Manager, or Technical Lead position.
* Strong hands\-on Microsoft Azure experience.
* Strong traditional infrastructure experience.
* Strong Windows Server and Active Directory knowledge.
* Strong networking fundamentals.
* VMware/virtualization experience.
* Backup, storage, monitoring, security, and disaster recovery experience.
* Experience managing enterprise infrastructure AMS/support teams.
* Experience managing L1/L2/L3 resources and 24×7 support operations.
* Strong client\-facing and stakeholder\-management experience.
* Experience conducting client service reviews and operational meetings.
* Experience managing SLAs, KPIs, incidents, problems, and changes.
* Strong troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis capabilities.
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and customer communication skills.



**Preferred Certifications** 



* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert
* VMware certifications
* ITIL certification



  





 Certifications are preferred;
 **strong hands\-on technical and client\-management experience is more important.** 




  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 We are looking for more than a traditional Infrastructure Manager.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be able to operate across:
 



**Client Management → AMS Delivery → Team Leadership → Infrastructure Architecture → Azure Cloud → Hands\-on Troubleshooting → Major Incident Management → Security → Automation → Continuous Improvement** 




  





 The person should be comfortable speaking with a
 **client CIO or IT Director in one meeting and joining engineers on a technical bridge call to resolve a critical Azure or infrastructure problem in the next.** 




 This role requires someone who takes
 **end\-to\-end ownership of the customer, the AMS team, and the technology environment.** 




  





 I’d use
 **“IT Infrastructure \& Azure Cloud AMS Manager”** 
 as the posting title. It makes the three expectations—
 **client management, AMS leadership, and hands\-on infrastructure/Azure expertise** 
 —clear from the beginning.

**Req ID:** 383210
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Sr. AI Architect to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

Business Domain Architect – Manufacturing
  
  

Senior domain architect with 13\+ years experience combining deep business domain expertise with cloud (AWS, Azure), data, AI and agentic AI architecture. Strong AWS Azure Architecture experience with working knowledge in GCP.
  
  

**Locations:** Bangalore (but any location is Fine) Mode: Hybrid / client\-facing Primary cloud: Azure \+ AWS; GCP working knowledge Domain focus: Smart manufacturing, OT/IT, supply chain
  
  

**ROLE PURPOSE:** Own business and technology architecture for manufacturing transformation across shop floor, supply chain, quality, maintenance, engineering and aftermarket. Translate manufacturing strategy into scalable, secure and value\-driven cloud, data, AI and agentic AI architectures.
  
Define reusable patterns for smart factories, predictive maintenance, quality analytics, production optimization, supply chain control towers, digital thread, digital twins and agentic AI copilots
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES MUST\-HAVE EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS
  
  

* Demonstrate strong knowledge of manufacturing capabilities across plan, source, make, deliver, maintain and service value streams, and use this knowledge to shape current\-state and target\-state capability maps.
* Advise on manufacturing transformation initiatives, including smart factories, plant modernization, asset performance, predictive maintenance, quality analytics and supply chain control towers.
* Provide manufacturing\-domain architectural guidance for Azure and AWS solutions supporting data platforms, IoT and edge, APIs and events, microservices, security, reliability, observability and FinOps, without necessarily being responsible for hands\-on engineering or platform configuration.
* Define and guide secure OT/IT integration patterns across ERP, MES, PLM, QMS, EAM, SCM, historian and time\-series platforms, SCADA/PLC environments and industrial connectivity layers.
* Identify and shape AI and agentic AI use cases relevant to manufacturing, such as maintenance copilots, production\-planning agents, root\-cause analysis agents, supplier\-risk assistants and enterprise knowledge search.
* Understand and guide the application of RAG, vector search, tool use, human\-in\-the\-loop review, prompt and policy controls, evaluation, monitoring, responsible AI and data governance within manufacturing environments.
* Lead domain\-focused workshops with plant operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, CIO, CTO and COO stakeholders, enterprise architects, delivery teams and vendors across India and Portugal.
* Provide architectural oversight through reference architectures, architecture decision records, non\-functional requirements, risk reviews, vendor assessments and governance forums.
* Work closely with cloud, data, application, security, OT and AI engineering teams that are responsible for detailed design, development, configuration and implementation.
* 13\+ years in technology/consulting, including 5\+ years in architecture and 5\+ years in manufacturing domain programs.
* Deep manufacturing knowledge: discrete/process/hybrid manufacturing, Industry 4\.0, ISA\-95 concepts, OEE, quality, maintenance and supply chain operations.
* Hands\-on architecture depth in Azure and AWS; practical familiarity with GCP, hybrid cloud, identity, network, security, data and integration services.
* Strong command of cloud\-native patterns: container/serverless, APIs, events, lakehouse/warehouse, streaming, edge/IoT and integration platforms.
* Good AI and agentic AI architecture know\-how: LLMs, RAG, multi\-agent orchestration, vector databases, LLMOps/GenAIOps, guardrails and model risk.
* Ability to convert business outcomes into target architecture, transition states, investment roadmap and delivery backlog.
* Excellent English communication; able to work with India and Europe teams with CET/IST overlap

AWS

* Amazon Timestream / Kinesis / Managed Flink for time\-series and streaming Strong / Working / Awarenes / Gap

* Semantic search and governed data access for RAG

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional

About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. 674016a4.description:
**Date Posted:**
 2026\-08\-05
   

  

**Country:**
 India
   

  

**Location:**
 IN\-KA\-BENGALURU\-NORTHGATE \~ Sy No 2/2 Venkatala Village \~ SY NO 2/2 VENKATALA VILLAGE, Yelahanka Hobli
   

  

**Position Role Type:**
 Hybrid
   

  

 At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.
   

  

 Pratt \& Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.
   

  

 Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Function: Digital Technology (Global PMO)
   

  

 Reports To: Director / Head of Global PMO
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Technology Program Manager to lead complex, enterprise\-wide technology programs supporting strategic business initiatives across a global organization. This role is responsible for driving end\-to\-end program delivery while ensuring alignment with portfolio priorities, governance standards, and business objectives.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of technical program management, portfolio leadership, Agile delivery, and enterprise governance, with significant hands\-on experience using Planview as an enterprise portfolio management (PPM) platform. This individual will work closely with executives, business leaders, product organizations, architects, engineering teams, and PMO leadership to deliver predictable, high\-quality outcomes across globally distributed teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Enterprise Program Leadership
* Lead multiple, large\-scale cross\-functional technology programs from initiation through successful delivery.
* Develop integrated program plans, manage schedules, budgets, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.
* Ensure programs align with enterprise strategy, governance frameworks, and organizational priorities.
* Drive delivery excellence across multiple concurrent initiatives while balancing competing business demands.
* Portfolio \& Planview Leadership
* Leverage Planview to manage portfolio planning, demand intake, resource planning, financial tracking, roadmaps, and executive reporting.
* Ensure high\-quality portfolio data by promoting governance, data integrity, and standardized planning practices.
* Support portfolio prioritization, investment decisions, and capacity planning through Planview insights and analytics.
* Partner with Portfolio Managers and PMO leadership to improve portfolio visibility and delivery predictability.
* Champion adoption and continuous improvement of enterprise portfolio management processes and tools.
* Technical Program Management
* Coordinate complex technology initiatives involving multiple delivery teams, business functions, vendors, and technical stakeholders.
* Facilitate technical planning, dependency management, release coordination, and implementation readiness.
* Work closely with Solution Architects, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Delivery Leads to remove delivery impediments and mitigate risks.
* Drive issue resolution through proactive decision\-making and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Agile Delivery Leadership
* Lead programs using Agile, Hybrid, and traditional delivery methodologies based on program needs.
* Partner with Product Managers, Scrum Masters, and Release Train Engineers to improve delivery cadence and execution.
* Drive PI Planning, roadmap alignment, dependency management, backlog governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Promote Agile best practices while maintaining enterprise governance and delivery discipline.
* Executive \& Stakeholder Management
* Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology leaders across global organizations.
* Prepare and present executive\-level dashboards, program updates, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations.
* Lead governance forums, steering committees, and executive reviews with confidence and professionalism.
* Influence decision\-making across multiple organizations without direct authority.
* Global Delivery \& Vendor Management
* Lead globally distributed teams across North America, Europe, India, and other regions.
* Coordinate internal teams and external delivery partners to ensure successful program execution.
* Monitor vendor performance, delivery quality, and adherence to contractual commitments and organizational standards.
* Governance, Risk \& Financial Management
* Manage program financials, forecasting, resource utilization, and budget performance.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate program risks while proactively managing cross\-program dependencies.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise governance, audit, security, and PMO standards.
* Drive lessons learned and continuous improvement across the program portfolio.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline (Master's degree or MBA preferred).
* 10\+ years of progressive experience leading complex technology programs and enterprise initiatives.
* Proven experience managing enterprise portfolios and strategic technology programs within large global organizations.
* Hands\-on experience with Planview (Portfolios, Enterprise One, or equivalent) supporting demand management, portfolio planning, resource management, financial tracking, reporting, and governance.
* Experience working directly with North American (onshore) business stakeholders and executive leadership teams.
* Strong experience leading globally distributed delivery teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs with significant organizational impact.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology landscapes, digital transformation, and software delivery lifecycle.
* Extensive experience delivering initiatives using Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Hybrid, and traditional project management methodologies.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and executive stakeholder management skills.

61bb9093.title: Program Manager – AI Transformation & Change
61bb9093.description:
⚡We are your
 **Energy Technology Partner** 
 . We electrify, automate, and digitalize every industry, business, and home, driving efficiency and sustainability for all.
   

  

 At Schneider Electric, our values – IMPACT (Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork) – are the foundation of everything we do. Becoming an Impact Maker means turning sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization.
   

  

 Are you ready to lead the digital transformation to create a more sustainable world?🌳
   

  

 If you are up to challenge your creativity and make an impact, we are excited to welcome you!
   

  

**Schneider Digital** 
 is the digital department of Schneider Electric, leading the digital transformation in the company by giving support globally to our internal teams and our clients. Schneider Digital consists of 6 Digital Hubs worldwide which are strategically located to ensure a 24/7 support across the company (France, China, India, USA, Mexico and Spain). Our Digital Hub in Barcelona is formed by \+450 employees working in strategic projects and different roles such as Data, Cybersecurity, ERP, Cloud, Infrastructures, IT Project Management or Digital Marketing.
   

  

 DCR is the digital backbone of Schneider Electric, representing \~1,200 FTEs and FTCs across eight capability domains. As AI is projected to reshape every DCR role, The DCR AI Operations team has been established to stand up a governed programme that turns the AI vision into measurable delivery across all DCR capabilities.
   

  

 Phase 2 of the programme (H2 2026\) focuses on building the foundation: establishing governance structures, validating priority use cases through live pilots, and preparing the organisation for full\-scale deployment in Phase 3\. The Transformation \& Change stream is the backbone of this phase — responsible for programme governance, use case portfolio management, process reinvention, and capability upskilling across all domains.
   

  

 In this context, the
 **Program Manager** 
 is the operational lead of the Transformation stream and the central orchestrator of the overall programme, translating strategic intent into a governed and deliverable roadmap.
   

  

**What will you do?**
**Key Responsibilities**
 The Program Manager leads the Transformation stream and orchestrates the end\-to\-end programme.
   

  

 Scope: Transformation \& Change \| Value Realization \| Solution Design \| AI Delivery
   

  

* Set up the programme operating model \& governance – Programme leadership role
* Define the end\-to\-end programme operating model: roles, decision rights, RACI matrix, and organisational design.
* Establish and chair the governance cadence, from operational syncs to executive steering committees, ensuring appropriate escalation paths and decision clarity.
* Define programme\-level KPIs aligned to the value framework; drive delivery against H2 2026 milestones (operating model set\-up, pilot selection, reinvention vision, upskilling strategy).
* Coordinate the AI use case portfolio \& stakeholder alignment – Orchestration role
* Lead the review and prioritisation of the AI use case portfolio with the AI Hub, scoring and shortlisting the highest\-value cases from the 120\-case inventory.
* Manage cross\-functional interdependencies across all workstreams, proactively resolving conflicts, blockers, and resource constraints before they impact delivery.
* Build trusted relationships with DCR domain SPOCs, BU VPs, and capability leaders; act as the communication bridge between programme execution and executive leadership.
* Drive programme delivery \& enable pilot execution – Execution management role
* Oversee the delivery plan across Foundation Setup (Q3 2026\), Pilot Validation (Q4 2026–Q1 2027\), and Deployment Readiness at scale (2027\+).

4f14e56f.description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**The Future Begins Here:**
 At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future\-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
   

  

 Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.
   

  

**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity:**
 Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Technical Lead and Program Manager in the Donor Information System (DIS) space within the Plasma\-Derived Therapies (PDT) business unit, you will lead the strategic planning, development and enhancement of web applications using Angular, .NET Framework and .NET Core, as well as spearhead the modernization of scheduler jobs into an event\-based real\-time architecture. Your role will be pivotal in driving innovation and operational excellence including day to day delivery and requires a strong technical background, leadership abilities, and a strategic mindset to drive the project to success. You will establish and enforce best practices, lead the delivery of scalable and secure solutions, and ensure that the execution aligns with critical project/business objectives. You will also be instrumental in fostering a culture of technical and engineering proficiency, mentoring a team of software developers and data engineers. Collaborating closely with business stakeholders and global leadership, you will ensure that the team’s efforts enhance business capabilities and drive forward the strategic goals of PDT as well as Takeda. Your leadership will be key in advancing the technology landscape to support the evolving needs of the global marketplace.
   

  

 This position will align to the ICC and report to the PDT Delivery Lead for strategic direction as well as day\-to\-day management.
   

  

 How you will contribute
   

  

* Lead and manage cross\-functional teams spanning different role types and own end to end delivery.
* Establish and nurture a positive team culture.
* Drive innovative thinking and identify opportunities for process improvements and new methodologies
* Oversee the development and enhancement of web applications, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Design and implement robust, scalable, and maintainable architectures for web applications and event\-based jobs and task scheduler.
* Conduct regular code reviews to ensure code quality, performance, and security.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other stakeholders, to align technical solutions with business goals.
* Deliver robust solutions by following the product development lifecycle from requirement gathering to production deployments and hypercare.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for all development processes, including architecture discussions, design, and code reviews.
* Optimize application performance and ensure scalability.
* Identify and resolve issues, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
* Work closely with business and IT teams to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and availability across different systems.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in technologies, recommending new tools and techniques to enhance capabilities.
* Lead discovery workshops with stakeholders from different product teams.
* Oversee projects from conception to deployment, managing timelines, resources, and risks effectively.


**Minimum Requirements/Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a similar field required. Master's degree in a similar field would be a plus
* 10\-14 years of professional experience in full stack development with a focus on .NET Core and C\# language.
* Hands\-on experience with Monitoring‑Driven Development (MDD) and Test‑Driven Development (TDD), ensuring proactive observability and high\-quality, test\-first engineering practices.
* Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Proven experience in leading and mentoring development teams.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts and hands\-on experience with Microservices, Dotnet core and AWS services.
* Exposure in front\-end development technologies such as HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and frameworks like Angular/ Angular JS or React.
* Experience with DevSecOps and secure SDLC practices, including hands\-on use of SonaType, JFROG, DAST, SonarCloud, and CodeQL for dependency scanning, vulnerability detection, and code quality enforcement.
* Proficiency with Git or other version control tools.
* Solid understanding of relational databases and experience with SQL.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to think strategically about complex issues.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Ability to manage and propose proper technology choices to determine what technology and methods can be combined for the optimal result in an ever\-changing product landscape.
* Understanding applicable regulatory compliance requirements surrounding PHI, PII, and GxP.


**Preferred Requirements**
* Understanding event\-based real\-time architectures and technologies such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or Lambda functions.
* Experience with project management tools like Jira.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to enhance productivity, code quality, and developer efficiency.
* Understanding of legacy technologies (VB6/VB.NET) is an advantage.


**BENEFITS:**
 It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are
   

  

* Competitive Salary \+ Performance Annual Bonus
* Flexible work environment, including hybrid working
* Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance Plans for self, spouse, and children
* Group Term Life Insurance and Group Accident Insurance programs
* Employee Assistance Program
* Broad Variety of learning platforms

221f953f.title: Senior SAFe Program Manager / Release Train Engineer
221f953f.description:
**About Amgen**
 Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients
   

  

 At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas—Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease—we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines that help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for solving complex problems, enabling high\-performing teams, and driving meaningful business outcomes, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team.
   

  

 Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Role Description
   

  

 The Senior SAFe Program Manager / Release Train Engineer is a strategic Lean\-Agile leader responsible for enabling successful execution across one or more Agile Release Trains (ARTs). This role partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Business stakeholders, and leadership teams to deliver high\-value digital solutions while fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and execution excellence.
   

  

 As a servant leader, coach, and facilitator, the Senior RTE helps teams achieve higher levels of Agile maturity by facilitating Program Increment (PI) execution, managing cross\-team dependencies, mitigating risks, and ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and delivery outcomes. The role also plays a key part in driving Lean\-Agile transformation, coaching leaders and teams, and continuously improving delivery practices across the organization.
   

  

 This position benefits from expertise in biopharma R\&D domains and enterprise informatics solution delivery. Success in this role requires extensive collaboration with global teams, strong experience across the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, and the ability to influence without authority within a highly matrixed organization.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and facilitate Agile Release Train (ART) execution using SAFe principles and Lean\-Agile practices.
* Drive successful planning and execution of Program Increment (PI) Planning, Scrum of Scrums, Inspect \& Adapt workshops, Solution Demos, and other ART ceremonies.
* Partner with Product Management, Product Owners, Engineering, Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment between strategic priorities and execution.
* Enable predictable, high\-quality delivery by improving flow, removing impediments, managing risks, and resolving cross\-team dependencies.
* Coach Scrum Masters, Agile teams, Product Managers, and leaders to continuously improve Agile maturity and delivery effectiveness.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement through retrospectives, data\-driven decision making, innovation, and Lean thinking.
* Monitor ART health using delivery metrics and Agile performance indicators, providing transparent reporting and actionable insights to leadership.
* Drive execution of strategic portfolio initiatives across multiple cross\-functional teams while balancing business priorities and organizational objectives.
* Facilitate collaboration across globally distributed teams to ensure seamless delivery and operational excellence.
* Manage and optimize the flow of value through the Agile Release Train using tools such as Program Kanban, Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, and other Agile information radiators.
* Coordinate with support, operations, and service teams to ensure successful product releases and issue resolution.
* Lead organizational readiness activities for PI Planning, including stakeholder alignment, dependency management, communication, and planning logistics.
* Champion Lean\-Agile transformation by coaching leaders and influencing organizational change that improves execution and business outcomes.
* Support continuous evolution of Agile delivery practices, governance models, and operational excellence across the organization.


 What we expect of you
   

  

 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Biotechnology, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 12–17 years of experience in software delivery, Agile program management, product delivery, or related technology leadership roles.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* Strong expertise in Agile methodologies, particularly the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
* Experience serving as a Release Train Engineer, Agile Program Manager, Scrum Master, or similar enterprise Agile leadership role.
* Proven experience facilitating PI Planning and other SAFe events across multiple Agile teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile software delivery and the end\-to\-end Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* Hands\-on experience with Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, and Agile planning/reporting tools.
* Experience identifying, managing, and resolving cross\-team dependencies, risks, and impediments.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence leaders and teams across a global matrix organization.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coach teams and leaders while driving continuous improvement and organizational agility.
* Demonstrated experience managing data\-focused projects, including initiatives involving data platforms, data integration, analytics, or data transformation.
* Provide people leadership by coaching, mentoring, and developing team members, fostering a high\-performing, collaborative, and accountable culture while supporting individual growth and organizational objectives.


 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industries.
* Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD, and Test Automation.
* Experience supporting enterprise portfolio planning and Lean Portfolio Management.
* Workshop facilitation, organizational change management, and Agile transformation experience.


 Professional Certifications
   

  

 Preferred certifications include:
   

  

* Certified SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE)
* SAFe Program Consultant (SPC)
* PMI Project Management Professional (PMP)
* Certified Scrum Professional (CSP) or equivalent Agile certification


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong servant leadership and coaching mindset.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to influence without authority across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Strong collaboration and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on execution and business outcomes.
* Commitment to continuous learning and continuous improvement.


 What you can expect of us
   

  

 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we'll support your journey every step of the way.
   

  

 In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans aligned with local market practices.

4b75bb0f.title: Technical Architect - R&D
4b75bb0f.description:
Mavenir is building the future of networks and pioneering advanced technology, focusing on the vision of a single, software\-based automated network that runs on any cloud. As the industry's only end\-to\-end, cloud\-native network software provider, Mavenir is transforming the way the world connects, accelerating software network transformation for 250\+ Communications Service Providers in over 120 countries, which serve more than 50% of the world’s subscribers.

**Role Summary**


An experienced 5G Packet Core Development Lead to lead the design and development of next\-generation cloud\-native 5G Core network functions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in 5G Packet Core architecture, microservices\-based software development, cloud\-native technologies, and distributed systems. The role involves leading a team of software engineers in delivering scalable, high\-performance, carrier\-grade network functions while driving engineering excellence and innovation.  

  

The successful candidate will combine deep telecom domain expertise with modern cloud\-native software engineering practices, enabling the development of scalable, resilient, and high\-performance 5G Packet Core solutions while providing strong technical leadership to engineering teams.**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of cloud\-native 5G Packet Core network functions.
* Drive end\-to\-end software development using microservices architecture and modern software engineering practices.
* Lead technical discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and architecture decisions.
* Collaborate with system architects, product management, QA, DevOps, and integration teams to deliver high\-quality releases.
* Design highly scalable, resilient, and fault\-tolerant distributed systems.
* Optimize packet processing performance, latency, and resource utilization.
* Ensure compliance with 3GPP standards and interoperability requirements.
* Drive CI/CD adoption, automated testing, and DevSecOps practices.
* Participate in customer issue analysis, performance optimization, and production support.
* Own feature delivery, technical planning, effort estimation, and release execution.

**Job Requirements**


Required Technical Skills

* 5G Packet Core
	+ Strong understanding of 5G Core architecture.
	+ Hands\-on experience with one or more core network functions such as:
	+ Good understanding of Service\-Based Architecture (SBA).
	+ Strong knowledge of 3GPP specifications and interfaces.
	+ Experience with HTTP/2, REST APIs, TLS, Diameter, and SCTP.
	+ Knowledge of QoS, mobility management, session management, charging, and policy control.

* Software Development
	+ Strong proficiency in C\+\+, Go, and Python.
	+ Expertise in microservices architecture and distributed systems.
	+ Experience developing REST/gRPC APIs.
	+ Strong object\-oriented design and design patterns.
	+ Multithreading, asynchronous programming, concurrency, and performance optimization.
	+ Excellent problem\-solving and debugging skills.
	+ Linux systems programming.
	+ Networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, UDP, IPv4/IPv6, and packet processing.
	+ Strong experience in cloud\-native and microservices\-based application development.
	+ Experience working with Kubernetes\-based deployments in production environments.

* Cloud Native Technologies

	+ Kubernetes
	+ Helm
	+ Service Mesh (Istio or Linkerd)
	+ Cloud\-native application development
	+ Container orchestration

* DevOps
	+ Git

**Accessibility**

5d1ce618.title: Data Solutions Engineer
5d1ce618.description:
The Opportunity
  
  

The Digital Transformation and Data Intelligence team is looking for a Data Solutions Engineer. This role will build scalable data products, automation, and AI\-enabled solutions that improve how CAO teams operate.
  
  

This individual contributor role requires deep data engineering expertise and strong product thinking. The candidate can turn ambiguous business problems into practical, production\-ready solutions. The foundation of the role is data engineering, but the scope extends into APIs, automation workflows, AI\-enabled capabilities, and lightweight applications that help teams make better decisions, reduce manual work, and unlock value from data.
  
  

You will partner with business collaborators, analysts, program leaders, architects, and engineers to translate business needs into scalable solutions. You will also help improve the team’s engineering standards and encourage adoption of modern development practices.
  
What you'll Do
  
  

Develop, build, and support data solutions that scale efficiently, including data streams, schemas, interfaces, and automation workflows.
  
Translate ambiguous business requirements into clear technical solutions and delivery plans.
  
Build automation and intelligent solutions that improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and increase operational capacity.
  
Apply modern engineering practices, including source control, testing, CI/CD, code reviews, documentation, monitoring, and production support.
  
Evaluate, integrate, and optimize data from internal and external systems.
  
Contribute to reusable patterns, engineering standards, and technical direction for data products.
  
Mentor engineers, review designs and code, and help the team effectively use AI\-assisted development tools.
  
What you need to succeed
  
  

7\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering, automation engineering, or a related technical field.
  
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building reliable data pipelines, data models, APIs, and automated workflows.
  
Experience with cloud data platforms, data warehouses, orchestration tools, Git\-based development, and CI/CD practices.

 You will work closely with regional delivery teams, project managers, solution architects, product teams, and other global stakeholders to ensure consistent delivery excellence and further strengthen the contribution of our offshore delivery organization.
