7e31d05b.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Retail & AI Solutions
7e31d05b.description:
**About the Role**

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are senior engineers who embed directly with our retail clients to scope, build, and ship production software — not demos, not proofs\-of\-concept. You will sit with the client’s business and technology teams, translate ambiguous business problems into working systems, and own what you build from first deployment through stabilization.

This is a hands\-on engineering role with a consultant’s context: you will spend part of your week in discovery conversations with merchandising, store operations, e\-commerce, and supply chain stakeholders, and the rest writing production\-grade code that solves what you heard. AI is central to how we deliver — you will build LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows, and you will use AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code as a core part of your daily engineering practice.

*This is not a pre\-sales or demo role. There is no sales quota. Success is measured by working software in the client’s production environment and the business outcomes it drives.*

**What You Will Do**

* **Discover and scope:** Embed with retail client teams to understand the real business problem beneath the stated ask — across areas such as e\-commerce, POS, order management, inventory, pricing/promotions, and supply chain — and define solutions where no spec exists.
* **Build production software:** Design and ship full\-stack applications and services (Angular front ends, Node.js/TypeScript back ends, REST/GraphQL APIs) inside or integrated with the client’s environment.
* **Engineer AI solutions:** Build LLM\-powered features — retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, tool/function calling, prompt pipelines — and take them from prototype to production with proper evaluation, guardrails, and monitoring.
* **Work AI\-natively:** Use Claude Code and similar AI\-assisted development tools to compress delivery timelines, and help client engineering teams adopt these practices effectively and safely.
* **Integrate with enterprise systems:** Connect to the client’s existing landscape — commerce platforms, ERP/OMS/WMS, POS, data warehouses, identity/SSO — and navigate security, compliance, and change\-management processes.
* **Own what you ship:** Handle deployment, monitoring, incident response, and iteration after go\-live; stabilize and improve rather than hand off and leave.
* **Close the loop:** Feed field learnings back into our delivery playbooks, reusable assets, and product/solution roadmap.

**Must\-Have Qualifications**

* 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems end\-to\-end (not only feature work within a large team).
* Strong full\-stack skills: Angular (or a comparable modern SPA framework with willingness to work in Angular) and Node.js/TypeScript, plus solid fundamentals in API design, SQL/NoSQL data modeling, and testing.
* Hands\-on AI engineering experience: you have built and shipped at least one real LLM\-powered application or workflow (RAG, agents, tool calling, prompt engineering, evals) — beyond tutorials or personal experiments.
* Working fluency with AI\-assisted development — Claude Code, or equivalent agentic coding tools — and sound judgment about where they accelerate work and where they need human review.
* Retail domain exposure: you have delivered software for retail or consumer commerce businesses and can speak the language of at least one area — e\-commerce, stores/POS, order management, inventory, pricing, or supply chain.
* Client\-facing strength: experience working directly with business stakeholders, comfort presenting and defending technical decisions, and the ability to operate with incomplete information.
* Cloud deployment experience on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including CI/CD and basic observability.
* Willingness to work onsite at client locations, with travel as required by the engagement.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with the Anthropic API / Claude models, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or agent frameworks such as LangGraph or the Claude Agent SDK.
* Python for data and AI workloads; exposure to data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks) and pipeline tooling.
* Direct experience with retail platforms and systems — e.g., commerce platforms (Salesforce Commerce, Shopify, commercetools), SAP or other ERPs, OMS/WMS, or POS systems.
* Prior consulting, professional services, or startup experience where you owned outcomes rather than tickets.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small delivery pods.

**Who Thrives in This Role**

FDEs are generalists with depth: engineers who are energized by ambiguity, get satisfaction from seeing their software used by real businesses within weeks, and are comfortable being the technical face of the company at a client site. If you prefer a fixed backlog, a single codebase, and minimal stakeholder contact, this role is probably not the right fit — and that’s okay.

**Why VirtuosicTechnologies**

* Work at the intersection of retail and applied AI, on problems where your code visibly moves business metrics.
* An AI\-native engineering culture: Claude Code and agentic tooling are part of how we build, not an afterthought.
* High ownership and fast feedback loops — you scope it, you build it, you run it.
* A pathway to senior client\-facing technical leadership (Principal FDE / Engagement Architect).

Pay: ₹3,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

6bf1f74d.title: Solutions Architect - India
6bf1f74d.description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.
   

  

 This is a deeply technical, post\-sale role embedded inside Cursor’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high\-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
   

  

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
   

  

 This role is highly hands\-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long\-term architecture for AI\-native development.
   

  

 The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI\-Native Development**
* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands\-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time\-to\-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly


**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**
* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company\-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI\-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments


**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**
* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI\-native development evolves


**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**
* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization


**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**
* Deepen workflow adoption and long\-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without


**Shape the Future of the Product**
* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns


**You may be a fit if**
* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

34f8aebf.title: Software Engineering Manager, Looker, Google Cloud
34f8aebf.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C\+\+, Java, JavaScript).
* 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
* 5 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.
* 2 years of experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs, multi\-modal, large vision models) or with GenAI\-related concepts (e.g., language modeling, computer vision).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 5 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of approximately 6\-10 software engineers responsible for delivering an exceptional client experience for Looker. Your role is to build a team and guide them to execute on cloud data analytics priorities. You will hire, develop, and retain a team of software engineers. You will be responsible for their career growth, providing coaching, and managing performance to build an exceptional engineering organization. You will ensure the team's roadmap directly supports the critical goal of differentiated BI experiences using AI. You will collaborate closely with Product Management, other Cloud Data engineering teams, and customer\-facing roles to respond to customer needs, and influence product direction.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Cultivate a team environment that is psychologically safe and encourages collaboration and innovation. Empower your team to take ownership and deliver outstanding results. Partner with Product Management and technical leads to define and execute the technical strategy for Looker.
* Guide the team through complex architectural decisions and ensure high standards for code quality are maintained through effective design and code review processes. Improve the end\-to\-end customer experience, from ease of use to debuggability and raw performance. Help customers profile their workload, and tune it for GCP.
* Ensure the team delivers high\-quality software on time. Set priorities, manage the project execution, and communicate progress and risks to stakeholders across the organization.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

* Creates secure and high\-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems using Java, Oracle and Cloud Technologies
* Participates in the maintenance of current state systems built on mature technologies such as Informatica ETL.
* Familiar with or willing to learn industry standard off the shelf back office management tools such as Eagle and XSP.

**What You'll Do**  

The Solutions Engineer is a customer\-facing technical expert who bridges the gap between product, engineering, customer service, operations and sales to design, demonstrate, and implement scalable solutions. This role translates business requirements into technical architectures, leveraging APIs, configurations, workflows, and cloud platforms to deliver measurable customer value.


You will partner across teams to accelerate revenue, enable successful implementations, and ensure customers fully realize the value of our platform.


**Responsibilities:**

**Customer \& Pre\-Sales Engagement**  

* Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer business needs, systems, and architecture.
* Design and present tailored solutions aligned to customer use cases and outcomes.
* Deliver compelling product demos, solution walkthroughs, and executive\-level presentations.
* Support RFP/RFI responses and address technical objections throughout the sales cycle.

**Solution Architecture \& Design**  

* Architect scalable, secure, and high\-performing solutions leveraging APIs, integrations, and cloud\-native services

* Define integration patterns (REST, event\-driven, batch, middleware) and system interoperability approaches
* Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and implementation blueprints

**API \& Integration Development**  

* Design, implement, and support API\-based integrations between internal and external systems (REST, GraphQL, webhooks)

* Support proof\-of\-concept (PoC) builds and pilot implementations

**Implementation \& Customer Success Enablement**  

* Guide customers through onboarding, configuration, and technical implementation
* Partner with Customer Success and Delivery teams to ensure seamless handoff post\-sale
* Provide best practices for system configuration, automation, and optimization
* Enable customers to adopt advanced capabilities (automation, analytics, AI\-driven features)

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**  

* Act as the liaison between customers and Product/Engineering teams, influencing roadmap based on real\-world needs
* Collaborate with Product to refine APIs, integrations, and developer experience
* Support Sales teams with technical enablement and ongoing education
* Contribute to reusable assets (demo environments, integration templates, solution accelerators)
**What You Will Need to be Successful:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Typically 3–8\+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or similar role
* Experience in SaaS, cloud platforms, or enterprise software environments
* Proven track record supporting complex technical sales cycles and implementations
**What You May Need to be Successful:**

**Core Technical Competencies**  

API \& Integration
  

* Expertise in APIs (REST, GraphQL, SOAP), webhooks, and microservices architecture
* Experience with integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Workato, Zapier)
* Familiarity with data formats and transformation (JSON, XML, ETL processes)

**Cloud \& Modern Architecture**  

* Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Knowledge of distributed systems, containerization, and serverless architectures
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

**Programming \& Technical Skills**  

* Proficiency in one or more languages (Python, JavaScript/Node.js, Java, C\#)
* Experience with SDKs, API documentation tools (Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI)
* Ability to debug complex system interactions and integration issues

**Data \& Automation**  

* Experience integrating enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS, marketing platforms)
* Familiarity with event streaming, messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Exposure to AI/ML or automation tools (increasingly valuable in modern environments)

**Business \& Soft Skills**  

* Strong ability to translate technical concepts into business value and outcomes
* Consultative approach to problem\-solving and solution design
* Excellent communication and presentation skills across technical and executive audiences
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in fast\-paced, customer\-facing environments
* Strong collaboration across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success functions
* Accelerates deal velocity by removing technical barriers and building customer confidence
* Delivers scalable, implementable solutions that drive customer adoption and retention
* Acts as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders
* Influences product direction through customer insights and technical expertise

 Slb has an opening in Coimbatore / Pune, India and Bogota, Columbia for a Technical Lead who will work on the Development / configuration for all modules / capabilities, changes and bug fixes related to Planisware and Microsoft .Net suite of applications in the Product and Service Delivery Function under Enterprise Solutions.
   

  

 The end users supported are the global community in Slb using these systems. Both L1 support and L2 support is provided in\-house while L3 Development and Support is outsourced to vendors.

Further, he/she will define periodic release plans and release schedules in coordination with the domain teams and the L3 vendor while being supervised by the Chief Scrum Master. Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment

 Release Management

* Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
* Ensure technical documentation is kept up to date by the development team
* Proactively identify and implement procedures to streamline the build process which may drive the development and maintenance of an automated build process

a5ba3e81.title: ERP ALM Solution Architect -  Cloud ALM Transition & Custom Systems
a5ba3e81.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future\-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift.
   

  

 Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom\-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will:
   

  

****Architect the Pivot:****
 Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high\-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud\-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met.
   

  

****Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning:****
 You will orchestrate the end\-to\-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes.
   

  

****Govern Hybrid Landscapes:****
 You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP\-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Mastery of ALM Transition \& Toolsets: Expert\-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM
* 8\+ years of Custom Build \& Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom\-built enterprise software or side\-by\-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence
* SDLC \& DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API\-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration
* Advanced competency in using AI\-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings
* Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full\-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade\-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions
* Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom\-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards
* Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders
* English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership
* A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

### **Minimum qualifications:**

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.



As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers effectively adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the integration of Google Cloud within organizations, guiding them through the strategic and technical facets of their transformation journey. You will also manage the delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive long\-term customer adoption.  

  

In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including enterprise leaders and cross\-functional, geographically dispersed teams.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**

### **About Company**


Tudip Technologies Pvt. Ltd is a CMMI Level 5 extreme technology company. Careers at Tudip Technologies are not just jobs, but a promise of a bright and dynamic future. Tudip provides ample opportunities to grow within the company technically as well as a technocrat by promoting entrepreneurship. Tudip Technologies’ careers will enable you to help clients enhance and improve while you build your career. Tudip is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are a place which defines Integrity, Innovation, and Serenity. Tudip provides you a better platform that translates an individual into an experienced and immensely skilled professional through an ethical and vibrant business environment. We are here for effective client servicing, taking care of our employees’ needs, and creating a success story to remember.

  



### **About the Role**


We are looking for a customer\-focused and technically proficient Product Solutions Consultant to drive product demonstrations, solution consulting, and pre\-sales engagements for our AI products, Testily and VoXgent. In this role, you will be the bridge between prospects, the sales team, and the product organization. You will understand customer business challenges, demonstrate product capabilities, manage post\-demo follow\-ups, support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and help convert opportunities into successful customer engagements. This role requires excellent communication skills, business acumen, product expertise, and the ability to present complex technical concepts simply and compellingly.

  



Please read the job criteria below and drop us an email at **joinus@tudip.com** OR create an account on our **Recruitment Portal** to get started.

  



### **Key Responsibilities**


#### **Product Demonstrations**


* Conduct engaging, customized product demonstrations for Testily and VoXgent.
* Tailor demonstrations based on customer industry, use cases, and business objectives.
* Showcase AI capabilities, integrations, automation workflows, and enterprise features.
* Deliver both virtual and onsite product presentations.

#### **Discovery \& Solution Consulting**


* Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer requirements, business processes, and pain points.
* Recommend product capabilities and solution approaches aligned with customer needs.
* Translate technical functionality into clear business value.

#### **Sales Support**


* Partner with Account Executives throughout the sales lifecycle.
* Assist in opportunity qualification and solution positioning.
* Support RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and customer presentations.
* Participate in customer meetings, workshops, and executive presentations.

#### **Post\-Demo Follow\-up**


* Ensure timely follow\-up after every demonstration.
* Address customer questions and coordinate with Product and Engineering teams where needed.
* Track action items and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle.
* Schedule and coordinate follow\-up meetings, workshops, and PoCs.

#### **Proof of Concept (PoC)**


* Coordinate PoC planning and execution.
* Configure product demonstrations for customer\-specific scenarios.
* Monitor PoC success criteria and provide regular updates.
* Ensure successful completion of PoCs leading to commercial discussions.

#### **Product Expertise**


* Develop deep expertise in Testily and VoXgent features, AI capabilities, integrations, and product roadmap.
* Stay current with competitor offerings and industry trends.
* Provide actionable customer feedback to Product Management.

#### **Customer Relationship Management**


* Build trusted relationships with prospects and enterprise stakeholders.
* Act as the product advisor during evaluation cycles.
* Ensure a professional and consultative customer experience.

#### **Collaboration**


* Work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing teams.
* Contribute to demo environments, knowledge repositories, and product collateral.
* Participate in product launches, webinars, customer events, and industry conferences.

#### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* 3–8 years of experience in Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, Product Consulting, or Sales Engineering.
* Experience demonstrating SaaS, AI, CRM, QA Automation, or Enterprise Software products.
* Strong presentation and storytelling skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Ability to understand customer business challenges and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings when required.

#### **Preferred Skills**


* Understanding of AI and Generative AI concepts.
* Knowledge of software testing, QA automation, and SDLC.
* Familiarity with contact center platforms, conversational AI, and enterprise integrations.
* Exposure to APIs, REST services, cloud platforms, and enterprise architecture.
* Experience with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, or other enterprise applications.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

#### **Key Competencies**


* Customer\-centric mindset
* Exceptional presentation skills
* Solution\-oriented thinking
* Business acumen
* Technical aptitude
* Stakeholder management
* Time management
* Negotiation and influencing skills
* Team collaboration
* Continuous learning

#### **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**


* Number of demos conducted per month

* Demo\-to\-PoC conversion rate
* PoC success rate
* Opportunity win rate
* Pipeline influenced
* Revenue supported
* Customer satisfaction (CSAT) after demonstrations
* Average follow\-up turnaround time
* Product knowledge certification completion
* Sales cycle reduction
* Demo environment readiness and quality

**Job Description Summary**
 We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Staff AI \& Cloud Solution Architect to lead the design and development of scalable AI platforms and intelligent solutions on AWS. This role requires deep expertise across AI/ML engineering, cloud architecture, MLOps, and Generative AI, along with strong experience in building enterprise\-grade, secure, and compliant SaaS platforms.
   

  

 You will be responsible for architecting end\-to\-end AI systems, enabling machine learning and deep learning engineering workflows, and driving innovation in GenAI and agentic AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, data architecture, and applied AI, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and governance.
   

  

 GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Platform \& Solution Architecture**
* Design and build scalable, multi\-tenant AI platforms on AWS supporting diverse ML and GenAI use cases.
* Define reference architectures, reusable components, and best practices for AI/ML systems.
* Architect end\-to\-end AI pipelines spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and monitoring.
* Ensure platform readiness for SaaS environments, including tenant isolation, scalability, and cost optimization.


**Machine Learning \& Deep Learning Engineering**
* Lead development of machine learning and deep learning models for production\-grade applications.
* Establish standards for ML engineering, including data preprocessing, feature stores, training pipelines, and inference services.
* Optimize model performance, scalability, and latency for real\-time and batch inference systems.


**Generative AI \& Agentic AI Systems**
* Design and implement Generative AI solutions using AWS Bedrock and foundation models.
* Build RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector databases and embeddings.
* Develop agentic AI systems, including autonomous agents, orchestration frameworks, and tool integration.
* Apply advanced techniques such as prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails.


**AWS Cloud Architecture**
* Architect and implement solutions using:
* AWS SageMaker (training, pipelines, deployment)
* AWS Bedrock (GenAI services)
* Compute: Lambda, ECS, EKS
* Orchestration: Step Functions
* Storage/Data: S3, Redshift, DynamoDB, Glue
* Build highly available, fault\-tolerant, and cost\-optimized cloud\-native systems.

ac23d3da.title: ServiceNow Architect
ac23d3da.description:
Company Profile:
   

  

 Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
   

  

 Job Title: ServiceNow Architect
   

  

 Position: Associate Consultant
   

  

 Experience: 12\+ Years
   

  

 Category: IT Infra
   

  

 Shift: US Shift
   

  

 Main location: Bangalore/Hyderabad
   

  

 Position ID: J0726\-1359
   

  

 Employment Type: Full Time
   

  

 Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 03 years of relevant experience.
   

  

**Job Description**
 A skilled and experienced ServiceNow Developer/Architect to design, implement, and optimize solutions across multiple ServiceNow modules, including IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD), Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), Configuration Management Database (CMDB), Software Asset Management (SAM), Hardware Asset Management (HAM), Generative AI (Gen AI), and system integrations. This role requires a deep understanding of ServiceNow capabilities, best practices, and customization to align with business requirements and drive digital transformation.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* ITSM (IT Service Management): Configure and enhance core ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management. Develop custom workflows, automation, and integrations to improve IT service delivery. Collaborate with service owners to optimize user experience and process efficiency.
* ITOM (IT Operations Management): Implement and optimize ITOM capabilities, including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Orchestration. Enhance monitoring, alerting, and automated responses to improve service uptime and operational resilience. Integrate ITOM with existing infrastructure to support automated workflows and event\-driven responses.
* HRSD (Human Resources Service Delivery): Configure and manage HR case management, employee self\-service portals, and knowledge management. Enable workflows to automate onboarding, offboarding, and other HR processes to streamline employee services. Collaborate with HR teams to ensure adherence to compliance, data privacy, and security standards.
* GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance): Design and implement GRC workflows to support policy and compliance management, risk assessment, and audit tracking. Automate risk reporting, assessments, and governance processes to enhance regulatory compliance and risk mitigation. Integrate GRC with other systems for real\-time monitoring and reporting.
* CMDB (Configuration Management Database): Develop, optimize, and maintain a robust CMDB to ensure accurate asset and service data. Implement CI relationships, manage CMDB health, and utilize the CSDM (Common Service Data Model). Support alignment of CMDB with ITSM and ITOM processes to ensure effective data consistency and utilization.
* SAM (Software Asset Management) \& HAM (Hardware Asset Management): Manage SAM/HAM processes, including license compliance, software/hardware tracking, and audit readiness. Automate asset lifecycle management, optimize licensing, and reduce asset\-related risks. Integrate SAM/HAM with other modules to create an end\-to\-end asset management solution.
* Generative AI (Gen AI): Utilize Gen AI capabilities to enhance ServiceNow modules, including virtual agent responses and predictive analysis. Integrate AI\-based automation to enhance self\-service, incident categorization, and resolution. Identify and apply AI\-driven insights to optimize workflows and reduce operational workloads.
* Integrations: Design and implement integrations with third\-party systems and applications, including REST, SOAP, APIs, and custom integrations. Ensure secure, scalable, and reliable integrations that facilitate seamless data exchange across platforms. Troubleshoot integration issues and monitor performance to ensure minimal downtime.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience: 12 \- 15 years of experience in ServiceNow Solution design, implementation, development and administration, with a deep understanding of multiple modules.
* Certifications: Preferred certifications include ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (for ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, GRC), and experience with Integration Hub.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in JavaScript, ServiceNow Scripting, Flow Designer, REST/SOAP, and API integrations. Worked on solution designs
* Soft Skills: Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills; ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders. Worked with client senior management.


 Additional Requirements:
   

  

* Proven experience in ServiceNow customizations, workflow automation, and performance optimization.

**Core Responsibilities** **AI Solution Design \& Delivery*** Translate client and internal business requirements into feasibility\-validated, buildable AI solutions — delivered, not just proposed.
* Design and deliver end\-to\-end AI solutions, including agentic workflows, AI integrations, automation pipelines, and LLM\-powered applications for internal and external customers.
* Package delivered solutions into documented, reusable assets that can be applied across engagements.
* Engage directly with US\-based clients in discovery sessions, workshops, and solution reviews as the technical AI subject matter expert.

**Agentic AI, Automation \& Workflow*** Design and build multi\-agent AI systems using LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Architect MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting AI agents to enterprise tools, data sources, and business workflows.
* Build agentic automation that executes real, multi\-step business processes with appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop oversight.
* Apply prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and vector database integrations to deliver accurate, context\-aware AI solutions at production scale.

**AI Integration \& Application Modernization*** Design AI\-assisted integration solutions that connect disparate systems, data sources, and platforms — platform\-agnostic, applicable across diverse client technology environments.
* Apply AI approaches to accelerate application modernization, legacy migration, and systems integration across client technology stacks.
* Build reusable AI accelerators for code analysis, migration planning, and integration mapping that can be deployed across engagements.

**Organizational AI Adoption \& Enablement*** Support internal teams and external clients in adopting and operationalizing AI, from readiness assessment through practical implementation and change enablement.
* Design AI guardrails and governance practices, including data handling, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and responsible AI use that are appropriate for client\-facing agentic systems.
* Build AI solutions that improve operational efficiency for both client organizations and Integrative's own internal teams and functions.
* Develop practical adoption frameworks, runbooks, and enablement materials that help non\-AI practitioners use and sustain delivered solutions.
* Recruit and mentor junior AI engineers; collaborate with Integrative's enterprise architecture group to ensure AI solutions align with broader technology standards.
* Continuously monitor emerging AI tools, frameworks, and platform releases; evaluate applicability and bring relevant recommendations forward.

**Required Skills \& Competencies****Agentic AI \& Orchestration*** LangChain and LangGraph — hands\-on production experience required. MCP (Model Context Protocol) design and implementation required.
* Multi\-agent frameworks (CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent) strongly preferred. Tool calling, memory management, context and state handling, RAG pipeline architecture.

**AI Integration \& Engineering Foundation*** Production\-grade Python; direct LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI); vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Azure AI Search).
* API\-first and microservices architecture; enterprise integration patterns; prompt engineering at scale.

**Microsoft \& Azure AI Platform*** Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Copilot Studio, Power Automate with AI Builder, Azure DevOps / CI\-CD.

**Delivery \& Communication*** Demonstrated ability to deliver AI solutions that generate measurable business outcomes — for both internal teams and external clients.
* Clear solution documentation and business communication; fluent written and spoken English; confident in client\-facing settings.
* Experience supporting organizational AI adoption — helping teams understand, use, and sustain AI solutions.
* Distributed (onshore/offshore) delivery experience preferred.

**Qualifications \& Experience**
We are looking for demonstrated applied AI architecture capability — not simply total years in the workforce. Strong, recent, hands\-on agentic AI delivery experience is preferred over a longer but more generic technology career.* 9–12 years of overall professional experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or technology consulting.
* Minimum 3 years in applied AI/GenAI engineering or architecture, in production environments — not academic or POC\-only work.

**About Integrative Systems:**

* We hire only the best. For a typical position, we sift through one hundred resumes and interview at least ten people. Make it in, and you'll be working with some of the best minds in the business. We understand that 'A' people attract 'A' people.
* We do not ride on anything short\-term \- no short\-term market trends, short\-term profits, or any short\-cuts. Hence, we look for talent who usually believes in stability and commitment more than short\-term benefits.

And because we address all these dimensions for every associate's wellbeing, we create an environment that fosters optimism, mindfulness, authenticity, belongingness, meaning, and vitality. meaning, and vitality.

We help more than 75\+ banks, hedge funds, and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability, and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.
   

  

* Designation: Pre\-Sales Consultant
* Relevant Experience: 2 \- 4 Years
* Qualification: MBA (Finance/Banking), CA, CFA, FRM, B.Com, M.Com, BBM, BE/B.Tech or equivalent qualification


**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will support business development and sales engagements by understanding client requirements, positioning Surya’s solutions, and demonstrating the value of our products to banks, financial institutions, and corporate customers. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams across the complete sales lifecycle.

* Assist in solution positioning, proposal preparation, proof\-of\-concept discussions, and customer clarifications.
* Stay updated on banking, financial risk management, regulatory developments, and competitive product offerings.
* Travel to customer locations for meetings, demonstrations, workshops, and business development activities as required


**Required Skills**
*Functional*
* Good understanding of banking and financial services industry.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and map them to product capabilities.
* Exposure to Treasury, ALM, Liquidity Risk, Market Risk, IRRBB, FTP, Basel II/III, Stress Testing, or related risk management areas is desirable.
* Ability to prepare customer\-facing solution proposals, presentations, and business write\-ups.


*Technical*
* Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word – Mandatory.
* Ability to create clear solution decks, product collateral, and proposal documents.
* SQL basics and understanding of databases – Good to have.
* Understanding of enterprise software products and implementation lifecycle is an added advantage.


**Other Essential Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation, listening, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively across multiple teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Flexible and positive approach to work with willingness to travel based on business requirements.


**Preferred Experience**

* Prior exposure to Financial Risk Management products or banking product pre\-sales will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, fintech organizations, or enterprise software companies is preferred

**About ITCart**
 iTCart Private Limited is a global technology organisation redefining how industries operate in the age of Artificial Intelligence. Headquartered in Bengaluru and established across key innovation hubs in the USA, UK, KSA, UAE, and LATAM, iTCart leads AI\-native digital transformation for enterprises worldwide. **Position Overview**
 The Technical Pre\-Sales Manager will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with sales, prospects, customers, and delivery teams to create compelling solution presentations, proposals, demonstrations, and technical strategies that drive business growth. The ideal candidate will have 8–12 years of overall experience with a minimum of 3\+ years in Technical Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, or Solution Engineering and a passion for helping customers solve business problems through innovative technology solutions.

 Product Demonstrations \& Sales Enablement

 Cross\-Functional Collaboration

 Knowledge Management \& Innovation

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Winning technical proposals, RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and bid responses.

* Effective collaboration with engineering, architecture, sales, and delivery teams.

**Qualifications**

* Strong executive presence with the ability to engage senior decision\-makers.
* Strong business analysis and consulting capabilities.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills.
* Highly collaborative with sales, delivery, product, and leadership teams.
* Strong negotiation, influencing, and communication abilities.
* Strategic thinking with a customer\-centric mindset.
* High ownership and accountability for solution quality and deal success.


**Experience**

* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in Technical Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, or Solution Engineering.
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience designing and presenting technology solutions for enterprise customers.

 The Senior Solution Engineer plays a key role in assessing technology solutions, evaluating vendors, and supporting strategic technology decision\-making across the organization. Working closely with Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, and Digital teams, this role is responsible for maintaining visibility of the enterprise technology landscape, managing architecture repositories, and ensuring proposed solutions align with business, security, and architectural objectives.

* Support procurement and technology selection activities by providing technical recommendations and assessments.

* Develop and maintain technology landscape documentation, ensuring clear visibility of enterprise systems, platforms, and dependencies.

* Support application portfolio, technology lifecycle, and governance activities.

* Communicate technical findings, recommendations, risks, and opportunities to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to architecture governance processes and technology standards.


**Qualifications**
 Required
   

  

* 8\+ years of experience in IT, Technology, Infrastructure, Cloud, Data, or Business Systems environments.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to assess technologies and translate complex technical concepts into practical business recommendations.
* Broad technical knowledge across enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, networking, and cybersecurity.
* Experience evaluating technology solutions, platforms, vendors, and emerging technologies.
* Experience creating technical documentation, architecture artefacts, roadmaps, and technology inventories.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred**

 Planning \& Decision Making
   

  

* Ability to independently plan, prioritize, and execute work within established timelines.

* Conduct thorough reviews and assessments to ensure quality and desired outcomes.


 Impact \& Scope
   

  

* Provide technical leadership through technology assessments, architectural recommendations, and solution evaluations.
* Support strategic technology decisions through analysis of risks, dependencies, and business impacts.
* Influence technology direction across infrastructure, cloud, applications, and security domains.

5bc454dc.description:
How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?
   

  

 Our organization is accelerating its digital transformation to deliver an integrated, global digital system for the Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) sector. A critical part of this journey involves leveraging the AVEVA engineering design suite to its fullest potential.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly hands\-on Aveva Technical Solution Lead to spearhead the creation of custom features, integration of third party systems and technical solutions within the AVEVA ecosystem. Working closely with Product Managers, this role requires a strong solution and product mindset to build, troubleshoot, and maintain Aveva\-developed code using the Aveva SDK. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical programming expertise with a solid understanding of the EPC industry to deliver robust, scalable features that drive our digital engineering capabilities forward.1\. Hands\-on Feature Development
   

  

* Act as the primary technical solution lead and developer for new enhancement and extending the AVEVA suite of products using AVEVA SDKs, C\#, .NET, and PML.
* Design, write, test, and deploy high\-quality, maintainable code to create new features that directly support complex EPC workflows and provide UAT support to Business teams .
* Work for the integration with third party products like Aspen Tech, SAP and develop integration touch points.
* Ensure all custom development aligns with the overarching architecture, security protocols, and software factory standards.
* Troubleshooting and Code Maintenance
* Proactively troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues within both existing and newly developed AVEVA SDK code.
* Perform root cause analysis on technical incidents related to Aveva Custom components and implement sustainable, long\-term fixes to ensure operational stability.
* Conduct custom or Aveva SDK and component code reviews, optimize system performance, and establish technical best practices for AVEVA customizations.
* Product Collaboration \& Solution Design
* Partner closely with Product Managers and Product Experts to understand business requirements and translate them into actionable technical specifications.
* Provide technical support in technical analysis related to Data migration, scripting and automations working closely with Product Managers and Product Experts
* Apply a strong "product mindset" to technical problem\-solving—focusing on scalable, reusable solutions rather than one\-off custom scripts.
* Actively participate in agile development cycles and advise the Product Manager on technical feasibility and effort estimations.
* EPC Industry Alignment
* Leverage a strong understanding of the EPC industry to design solutions that accurately reflect the realities of engineering, procurement, and construction phases.
* Ensure that the features developed enhance the "Digital Thread," seamlessly connecting engineering data across the asset lifecycle.


 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_Are you a MATCH?
   

  

* Technical Expertise: Extensive hands\-on development experience specifically tailored to the AVEVA suite (e.g., Aveva Unified engineering, Aveva AIM , etc.) using AVEVA SDKs, .NET, C\#, and PML.
* EPC Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of the Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) industry, including its specific data models, workflows, and asset lifecycles.
* Troubleshooting Prowess: Proven track record of successfully debugging, reverse\-engineering, and maintaining complex custom\-developed code within enterprise engineering systems.
* Product Mindset: Strong ability to think in terms of scalable solutions and overarching products; experience working collaboratively alongside Product Managers in an Agile environment.
* Technical Leadership: Excellent problem\-solving skills, ability to lead code quality initiatives, and strong communication skills to bridge the gap between business needs and deep technical execution.
* Experience Level: 7\+ years of hands\-on software engineering and development experience within the plant design or EPC software ecosystem.
* Nice to have knowledge: end\-to\-end integration to other EPC tools such as Tekla, Solidworks, Aspen Tech

We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

2f86553f.title: Systems Architect
2f86553f.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
   

  

 This Position reports to:
   

  

 R\&D Leader(Industrial Software)\-AUEN BL
   

  

  

  

  

  

**What We Believe In**
 ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.
   

  

 We offer a broad range of automation, electrification, and digital solutions for process, hybrid, and maritime industries, including industry\-specific integrated control and software, as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.
   

  

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 In this role, we are looking for an experienced Product Architect to join our Industrial Automation Digital organization. You will define the architecture strategy and technical roadmap for next\-generation industrial software platforms built on Edge and Cloud technologies. As a key technical leader, you will drive architecture governance, engineering best practices, and technology adoption while collaborating with global engineering teams to build secure, scalable, and high\-performance SaaS and PaaS solutions.
   

  

 The work model for the role is: Hybrid
   

  

**You will be mainly accountable for**
* Define and drive the technical vision, architecture strategy, and engineering standards for Edge and Cloud\-based industrial software platforms, ensuring scalable, secure, resilient, and high\-performing enterprise solutions.
* Lead architecture design, technology selection, and governance by establishing reusable frameworks, cloud\-native patterns, AI\-enabled engineering practices, and cybersecurity standards while ensuring compliance with ABB Product Security Assessment (PSA) and industry frameworks.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Platform Engineering, and global stakeholders to develop product roadmaps, architectural runway, platform evolution strategies, and technical governance while mentoring engineering teams and promoting architecture excellence.
* Drive continuous platform optimization by reducing technical debt, improving developer productivity through AI\-assisted engineering, and maintaining comprehensive architecture documentation, threat models, and engineering best practices.


**Qualifications For The Role**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline with 12\+ years of experience in software architecture, platform engineering, and enterprise product development.
* Strong expertise in cloud\-native architectures, Docker, Kubernetes, Microservices, Microsoft Azure, SaaS/PaaS platforms, distributed systems, REST APIs, C\# .NET Core, relational and time\-series databases, with experience in React and TypeScript being desirable.
* Hands\-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI\-assisted software development, Specification\-Driven Development, and modern AI application architectures.
* Strong knowledge of event\-driven architectures, messaging platforms such as Kafka or MassTransit, Agile methodologies, Azure DevOps, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices.
* Good understanding of Industrial Automation architectures, Edge Computing, Industrial Communication Protocols, IT/OT systems, networking, and cybersecurity principles including OWASP, ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, and ABB Product Security Assessment (PSA).
* Proven experience designing secure, scalable, and highly available enterprise software architectures while driving technical governance, mentoring engineering teams, and influencing strategic technology decisions across globally distributed organizations.
* Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills with exposure to Industrial Automation, Process Industries, Energy, or Digital Manufacturing domains considered an advantage.


**More About Us**
 ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.
   

  

 The Process Automation business area automates, electrifies, and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial infrastructures across energy, process, hybrid, and maritime industries. Through advanced industrial software, cloud platforms, automation technologies, and AI\-driven digital solutions, ABB enables customers to improve operational efficiency, safety, reliability, and sustainability while accelerating the transition toward a low\-carbon future.
   

  

 Join ABB and become part of a global team that is shaping the future of industrial automation through world\-class engineering, cloud\-native platforms, and AI\-powered innovation.
   

  

 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
   

  

 Recruitment Fraud Warning
   

  

 ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

8b5791d0.title: Cloud Security Architect
8b5791d0.description:
**About Cognizant**
 Cognizant is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward\-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
   

  

 At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Cloud Security Architect** 
 , you will lead the design, validation, and governance of security architecture across enterprise cloud and hybrid environments. You will play a critical role in ensuring cloud\-native and hybrid architectures align with Cognizant’s security reference architecture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multi\-cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
   

  

 You will work independently with senior stakeholders, enterprise architects, security teams, cloud engineering teams, DevSecOps practitioners, and compliance leaders to provide end\-to\-end ownership of cloud security architecture from threat modeling and design reviews through implementation validation and operational governance. You will have the opportunity to influence strategic cloud adoption initiatives, modern security architectures, and enterprise\-wide cloud governance programs while mentoring teams and driving security excellence.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Govern the security architecture of enterprise cloud and hybrid environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and OCI platforms.
* Conduct cloud security architecture reviews covering Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), network segmentation, micro\-segmentation, and Zero Trust security models.
* Partner with Cloud Management Office, enterprise architecture, security, and engineering teams to integrate security requirements into cloud design and architecture decisions.
* Define and implement cloud security standards, architectural patterns, governance controls, and security guardrails.
* Embed security requirements into Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud automation frameworks.
* Collaborate with compliance and risk stakeholders to ensure cloud solutions meet regulatory and security requirements.
* Evaluate emerging cloud services, container platforms, serverless technologies, and AI\-enabled solutions while providing architectural guidance and security recommendations.
* Serve as the primary security architecture liaison between enterprise architecture, security governance, control validation, IT security, and business stakeholders.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) for cloud architecture initiatives.
* Lead architecture governance reviews, risk assessments, threat modeling exercises, and solution validation activities.
* Mentor security, architecture, cloud, and engineering teams on secure cloud operations and cloud security best practices.
* Stay current on cloud provider roadmaps, threat landscape developments, regulatory requirements, and industry security standards.


**What You Must Have To Be Considered**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in information security and cybersecurity architecture.
* 8\+ years of experience securing enterprise cloud environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and/or OCI.
* Proven experience designing and governing cloud security architectures for large\-scale enterprise deployments.
* Demonstrated experience leading cloud architecture security reviews and evaluating security controls against cloud frameworks and assurance programs.
* Experience implementing and governing cloud security requirements within DevSecOps environments.
* Strong expertise in cloud security architecture, threat modeling, risk management, and security governance.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, compliance, risk, audit, and operational stakeholders.
* Experience managing, mentoring, and guiding architecture, engineering, or validation teams.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for improving the security posture of cloud environments.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.


**These Will Help You Succeed**
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, including Landing Zones, Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Google Cloud Platform security services and governance frameworks.
* Experience with container platforms including AKS, EKS, and GKE.

7169be91.title: Technical Program Manager III
7169be91.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Technical Program Manager III**
---------------------------------

**Introduction to the team**
----------------------------

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.


Within this organization, the EG Metrics Platform (EGMP) team in the Data Platform organization is on a mission to build Expedia Group’s enterprise\-wide semantic layer — a centralized metrics platform that standardizes how business metrics are defined, computed, governed, and consumed across the company. As the single source of truth for critical business metrics such as bookings, revenue, visits, funnel progression, and conversion, we power executive reporting, experimentation, BI dashboards, and self\-serve analytics at scale. Semantic layers are increasingly vital in the age of LLMs and AI agents because they reduce hallucinations, enforce consistency, and enable trusted metric discovery. Our team is at the forefront of this shift, building an AI\-powered semantic layer with agentic capabilities for natural\-language metric exploration, intelligent anomaly detection, automated operations, and governed AI\-ready data access.


**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Lead planning and delivery of moderately complex, cross\-functional technical programs across multiple teams, aligning scope, priorities, timelines, and success metrics to business outcomes.
* Own delivery mechanisms for EGMP initiatives spanning governance, onboarding experience, adoption, reliability, cost transparency, and ecosystem integrations.
* Create visibility through dashboards, status reporting, milestones, dependency tracking, and structured decision\-making forums that improve accountability and delivery predictability.
* Partner across engineering, product, analytics, experimentation, and platform teams such as Pulse, TnL, Data Quality, OpenMetadata, and Yield \& Analytics to drive aligned execution on shared priorities.
* Influence trade\-off decisions without formal authority by using data, context, and structured communication to bring clarity to ambiguity and keep programs moving forward.
* Apply systems thinking to understand end\-to\-end platform flows, technical dependencies, upstream and downstream impacts, and architectural or operational risks early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Ensure operational readiness is built into program execution by partnering with engineering teams on monitoring, resiliency, incident readiness, learnings from production issues, and delivery risk mitigation.
* Drive programs that strengthen EGMP as a governed metrics foundation, including work related to certification, metadata quality, data quality integration, lineage, access controls, and authorized data usage.
* Drive programs that improve the speed and safety of onboarding, including sandbox or pre\-production workflows, reliability frameworks, duplicate detection, and better discovery or explorer experiences.
* Support adoption and consolidation efforts that establish EGMP as the single source of truth for reporting and experimentation metrics across Expedia Group.
* Use metrics and insight\-driven narratives to identify risk, guide prioritization, support leadership reviews, and improve execution health across platform programs.
* Contribute repeatable playbooks, templates, governance mechanisms, and process improvements that help scale TPM effectiveness and delivery excellence across the EGMP portfolio.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* You have 5\+ years of experience leading technical programs with cross\-functional dependencies in platform, infrastructure, data, analytics, or similarly complex engineering environments.
* Prior technical background and **core understand of SDLC is a foundational requirement for success** in this role
* You have experience planning and delivering moderately complex programs across multiple teams, including managing timelines, dependencies, risks, milestones, and execution reporting.
* You are skilled at building clarity and accountability through dashboards, status communication, governance mechanisms, and structured operating rhythms.
* You are comfortable influencing without authority and aligning engineering, product, and business stakeholders around trade\-offs, priorities, and next steps.
* You have strong technical fluency and can understand distributed systems, APIs, services, data flows, architecture discussions, and operational risks well enough to ask the right questions and surface gaps early.
* You use data and metrics to make program decisions, identify trends, surface risks, and tell a clear story to technical and leadership audiences.
* You have experience operating effectively in ambiguous environments and creating structure that helps teams move forward with confidence.
* You communicate clearly and concisely across different audiences and can translate complex technical or delivery topics into actionable updates and decisions.
* You bring a strong ownership mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to work collaboratively across teams, functions, and time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* You have experience working on data platforms, semantic layers, metrics platforms, experimentation platforms, BI or self\-serve analytics platforms, or developer\-facing platform products.
* You have experience supporting programs related to governance, metadata, lineage, access control, certification, or data quality.
* You have experience driving platform adoption or consolidation efforts across multiple customer groups and partner organizations.
* You have experience working with operational excellence programs involving reliability, monitoring, cost transparency, production readiness, or incident follow\-up.
* You have experience partnering with teams that support executive reporting, experimentation, and shared analytics capabilities at scale.
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is expected; a master’s degree is a plus.
